jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Role summary

Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day.

We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted.

Responsibilities

  • Product vision, grounded in real user needs

You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind.

  • Market scoping and opportunity-spotting

Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog.

  • Logistics know-how turned into product decisions 

Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you.

  • The full lifecycle

From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear.

  • The connective tissue across the company 

When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together.

The team you’ll join

You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today.

Life at Bluerock

We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock.


  • 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required.

  • Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field  required.

  • A track record of delivering complex, high-stakes software implementations, on time and within budget.

  • Genuine ease operating cross-functionally. You connect engineering, sales, implementation, and customers without waiting for permission.

  • An appetite for ambiguity and change: a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem.

  • Nice to have: API integration experience (WMS, ERP, visibility providers, customs), fluency with Agile tooling (Jira, Asana, Rocketlane), and PMP/PRINCE2 certification.

  • Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively.

  • Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment

Our hiring process

  • Hit the Apply button.

  • Join a 30 minute video call in the Introduction Interview

  • A couple of deeper interviews built to be a win-win, not an interrogation.

  • An offer, and the start of your journey with Bluerock TMS.


Bluerock TMS is an equal opportunities employer. We take pride in our diverse workforce and inclusive workplace. Within a small team of open-minded talents, we ensure an attractive learning environment that you are looking for!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.


Your Mission

  • Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
  • 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
  • Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
  • Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
  • Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
  • AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
  • Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
  • Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
  • Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
  • AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
  • Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
  • Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
  • Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
  • Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
  • Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.

Nice to Have
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.
  • Early-stage startup background.
  • Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering.
  • Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol and Berlin offices, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager Software
jobs.description:
About Optics11

Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

The Role

As Senior Product Manager Software you will build a deep understanding of the software we supply to our defense partners and clients.

You will have full product ownership including strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle and contribute to adjacent hardware product strategy and propositions to, jointly with our hardware product managers, build end-to-end solutions for our defense partners and clients. You build and structure our product discovery and delivery ways of working for the software domain.

You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with our hardware Product Managers, Data science, Software, R&D, Engineering Sales, Projects and Application Engineering teams.

No two weeks will look the same. You might speak with a defense partner about an operational challenge, turn feedback from a deployed product into a roadmap decision, test the feasibility of a new capability with System Engineering, or work with the Product Owner to translate priorities into executable increments. You will also collaborate with hardware Product Managers, Engineering, Sales and Customer Projects to ensure our software and hardware come together as one coherent solution.

You will own the software product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle, from discovery and business case through prioritization, delivery and performance.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have established a clear, evidence-based software strategy, strengthened our discovery and delivery practices, and aligned teams around the capabilities that matter most. Your work will reduce uncertainty, improve investment decisions and help Optics11 deliver scalable, commercially strong software products that solve real problems for customers operating in demanding, high-stakes environments.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the software product strategy by defining and articulating the direction for assigned software products or value streams, identifying customer problems and market opportunities, and balance near-term opportunities with long-term company goals.

• Provide product design authority by ensuring software concepts, capabilities and development choices remain aligned with the Underwater Security product vision and strategy throughout the product lifecycle.

• Lead customer and market discovery by developing a deep understanding of customer needs, operational use cases and buying contexts, validating direction with customers and partners, and synthesizing feedback from deployed products.

• Own software roadmap development and prioritization by defining the capabilities required to address validated needs, balancing improvements, new functionality and technology evolution, and communicating priorities across relevant teams.

• Develop business cases and commercial input by defining success measures and commercial objectives, providing evidence for portfolio investment decisions, and supporting Product Marketing with product knowledge for pricing and launch readiness.

• Coordinate the product core team by working with System Engineering on requirements and feasibility, Product Ownership on executable increments, and Project Management on customer delivery, while aligning Sales, Business Development, Customer Projects and Engineering around progress, quality and outcomes.


• Master’s degree in engineering or design, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of experience in Software Product Management, with a proven track record of developing, deploying and maintaining software (platform) driven solutions in defense industry or another industrial high-tech / high compliance environment

• Strong understanding of software products, particularly in complex and regulated environments, e.g., industrial environments.

• In-depth knowledge of software product management and – strategy methodologies.

• Demonstratable experience in defining software product strategy and creating complete business cases.

• Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level

• Demonstrated critical thinking, adaptability to challenges, and a problem-solving mindset to creatively address user pain points.

• Proficiency in software industry standard tooling for software development and road mapping such as Jira / Jira Product Discovery / Jira Service Management, Confluence, BigPicture

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of conveying product level knowledge, decisions and roadmaps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Willingness to travel

• Drivers’ license B (or international equivalent)

Nice to Have

• Experience in defense industry or another industrial high-tech / high compliance environment

• Proficiency in JAMA Connect, Siemens Polarion, SAFe, Miro, Figma, Dovetail, Amplitude, PowerBI

• Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus

Security screening

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please check:

https://english.aivd.nl/topics/s/security-screening

jobs.title: Product Owner (Microsoft, Koddex, outils collaboratifs)
jobs.description:
Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.

Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Votre rôle

Au sein de la DSI d'Exotec, vous serez responsable d'un portefeuille d'outils collaboratifs utilisés par nos Exopeople répartis en Europe, aux États-Unis et au Japon.

Votre mission consistera à définir la vision, piloter l'évolution et maximiser l'adoption des solutions collaboratives qui soutiennent les activités de l'entreprise. Vous interviendrez notamment sur l'écosystème Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Power Platform, Copilot, etc.) ainsi que sur Koddex, plateforme stratégique pour le partage des connaissances et la gestion de nos processus internes.

Véritable interface entre les métiers, les équipes IT et les partenaires externes, vous accompagnerez la transformation digitale d'Exotec en proposant des solutions à forte valeur ajoutée pour les utilisateurs.

Vos missions

Définir et piloter la stratégie produit

  • Porter la vision des outils collaboratifs et définir une roadmap cohérente avec les priorités métiers, la stratégie IT et les ambitions de transformation digitale d’Exotec.
  • Être responsable de la valeur produite par le portefeuille, en reliant chaque évolution à un résultat attendu pour les utilisateurs et l’entreprise.
  • Arbitrer les priorités du portefeuille en tenant compte de l’impact utilisateur, de l’adoption attendue, des contraintes techniques, des risques et de la soutenabilité des solutions.

Recueillir, challenger et prioriser les besoins

  • Être responsable de la discovery produit en recueillant des besoins de terrain auprès des utilisateurs, des métiers, de la DSI et des relais locaux en Europe, aux États-Unis et au Japon.
  • Challenger les demandes et distinguer les besoins structurants des préférences locales, en s’appuyant sur les données d’usage, les retours utilisateurs et l’impact business.
  • Garantir que les décisions de priorisation et de roadmap reposent sur des éléments objectifs, des résultats mesurables et une compréhension réelle des usages.

Piloter les évolutions et les déploiements

  • Piloter le cycle complet des évolutions, de leur cadrage jusqu’à leur mise à disposition, en garantissant la qualité, la sécurité, l’intégration et la valeur délivrée.
  • Définir les critères de réussite et les standards de qualité des solutions, afin de sécuriser leur déploiement dans l’écosystème Exotec.
  • Prendre les décisions de release et de cycle de vie en équilibrant valeur utilisateur, risques opérationnels, dépendances éditeurs et pérennité des plateformes.

Développer l’adoption et animer la gouvernance

  • Définir et porter la stratégie d’adoption des outils collaboratifs afin d’ancrer durablement de nouveaux usages, au-delà de la seule communication ou de la formation.
  • Être responsable de l’adoption effective, de la satisfaction des utilisateurs et de la réduction des irritants qui limitent l’usage de Microsoft 365 et de Koddex.
  • Aligner les métiers, la DSI, les utilisateurs clés, les éditeurs et les partenaires externes sur les priorités, les règles de gouvernance, les arbitrages et les résultats attendus.
  • Piloter la relation avec les éditeurs et partenaires stratégiques, en maîtrisant leurs engagements, leur feuille de route, leurs risques et leurs contraintes commerciales dans l’intérêt d’Exotec.
  • Garantir la cohérence, la rationalisation et l’évolution maîtrisée du portefeuille d’outils collaboratifs et de l’écosystème de connaissances.

Votre profil

  • Expérience en Product Ownership, gestion de produit ou transformation digitale.
  • Bonne connaissance des outils collaboratifs, idéalement Microsoft 365.
  • Appétence pour les environnements SaaS et la conduite du changement.
  • Capacité à faire le lien entre enjeux métiers et solutions techniques.
  • Maîtrise des méthodes Agile.
  • Anglais professionnel.

Benefits

  • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
  • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

 

Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi. Nous mettons en place un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux de toutes les différences. En rejoignant le Pacte Parité, Exotec s’engage pour un écosystème French Tech plus paritaire.

Client Delivery Lead - Payments
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Customer

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimising resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

We have been licensing Kraken since 2019. Throughout this time, the Delivery team has been at the forefront of industry-leading migrations, setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. These transformations go far beyond technology: we work with clients to rethink their operating models and ways of working, while continuously making the most of Kraken's evolving capabilities.

 

Client Delivery sits at the heart of Kraken’s transformation journeys, at the intersection of our clients and the product and engineering teams building Kraken 🚀 We lead conversations around our clients’ most important needs, help them unlock the value of Kraken and turn complex challenges into opportunities to evolve the platform, keeping Kraken innovative, relevant and ahead of where the energy market is going.

 

It’s a high-impact, hands-on team where you’ll influence both how our clients transform and what Kraken becomes next 💡 You’ll work alongside other Client Delivery Leads (across the same client and areas of expertise) as well as Transformation Directors and Technical Programme Leads, bringing together the right perspectives to challenge thinking, drive change and deliver the best possible outcomes for our clients.

 

🚀 What you'll own:

  • As a Client Delivery Lead you will be at the forefront of the transformation journey with our clients.

  • You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners).

  • You will have full ownership of a domain or product area for your client and act as a key point of contact for technology development and issue resolution within your domain or product area.

  • You will build a deep understanding of Kraken, as well as client needs and priorities, to provide expert advice and identify the best solutions, balancing the use of existing Kraken capabilities with the need for custom-built solutions.

  • You will triage and prioritise incoming requests, clearly articulating client needs, priorities and timelines to the right Kraken teams to support effective delivery and the ongoing development of the platform.

  • You will work closely with product managers and developers to translate client needs into clear priorities and support the delivery of product features.

  • You will challenge clients to think differently about technology development, championing Kraken's iterative approach and shared platform over bespoke solutions.

  • You will be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change.

 

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Strong client delivery, product ownership/management experience, including client-facing (often senior) stakeholder management.

  • Experience managing technology products, migration/implementation projects or complex delivery in an agile environment.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate complex client needs into clear action-plans and impactful solutions.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge traditional ways of thinking and drive change

  • Experience navigating complex delivery pipelines, competing priorities and changing environments.

  • A proactive, adaptable and hands-on mindset, willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, frequently flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organization.

  • Resilience and empathy, staying positive and persistent through challenges while understanding the human impact of transformation and supporting clients through change with patience and sensitivity.

  • We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open-minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever-changing environment.

⭐ Bonus points:

  • Consulting experience.

  • Experience with large-scale technology transformations, migrations or enterprise platforms.

  • Experience in energy, utilities or another regulated or complex industry.

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. jobs.title: Senior Creative Project Manager - Brand
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

The Creative Production studio team sits squarely within our Brand function working alongside our Brand Foundations team. You will report directly to the Director of Brand Strategy & Experience and join a tight-knit, highly experienced group of project management leads and producers.

In this role, you will lead our internal Creative Production studio team, the execution engine delivering all branded assets across Pleo, including campaign and performance assets, global adaptation and localization, event branding, content marketing, web, socials and lifecycle design. You will balance hands-on delivery with direct people management for a team of three in-house designers and copywriter, ensuring our creative output remains fast, scalable, and sharp across all touchpoints.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

Our Brand department is 13 people across two teams: Brand Foundations and Creative Production. You'll lead the four-person Creative Production studio, a senior copywriter, two senior designers and a motion designer, spread across our European offices. Day to day, you'll work alongside a peer project lead on Brand Foundations, a brand strategist, our producers, and internal partners in Events, Lifecycle, Performance Marketing, HR/People Ops and Legal, plus our media agency. Most of the studio's clients are internal teams across Pleo.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Creative Project Manager, you will:

Creative Production & Operations

  • Studio Ownership: Lead end-to-end execution across all creative production studio work streams, ensuring projects hit quality benchmarks, deadlines, and brand standards. This is also not just intake of brand requests but also spotting opportunities proactively for brand involvement and governance across the business.

  • Project Management: Own intake of BAU requests, filtering and assigning work while acting as the bridge between requestors and the studio team. Define scope upfront and ensure the team has what it needs to execute. Contribute to project plans for integrated campaigns and large events and manage Creative studio kick-offs, status reporting, and timeline and milestone tracking.

  • Core Output Focus: Oversee production for high-performing marketing assets, market localization and adaptations, event branding, and content marketing.

  • Process & Integration: Partner closely with peer project leads, producers, and the Brand Foundations team to streamline intake briefs, cross-team handoffs, and resource sharing.

  • Global Asset Delivery: Manage asset adaptation frameworks to keep our brand consistent across different regions and channels.

  • Capacity Planning: Own and manage resourcing across internal teams and freelance support, balancing capacity against demand and prioritizing against business needs when demands compete.

  • External agency partnerships: Serve as the lead creative point of contact for asset production with our media agency. Manage sprint-style monthly asset delivery in response to agency and internal performance team briefs, keeping output aligned with the media plan. Review final creative placements across Meta and LinkedIn to ensure assets display correctly on paid channels.

People Management & Leadership

  • Direct Management: Line manage, mentor, and foster career growth for a cross-functional team of three in-house designers and one copywriter overseeing their daily priorities and bandwidth.

Stakeholder Alignment & Strategy

  • Cross-Functional Partner: Serve as the strategic operational bridge connecting the studio with Marketing, Events, HR/People Ops, and Legal.

  • Leadership Alignment: Work closely with the Director of Brand Strategy & Experience and Associate Director of Brand Management to align studio output with broader brand goals and business priorities.

We launched our new brand in September, so this is a moment to build. The studio has the basics in place, but intake, briefing, project tracking and resourcing are still early. You'll set the ways of working that the studio runs on, and we'd love you to bring AI into how we plan, brief and produce.

What you bring


You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • In-House Brand Experience: Minimum 5-7 years of work experience. Solid background working in-house in a fast-paced brand function (tech, scale-up, or high-growth environment).

  • People Leadership: Direct experience line-managing creative talent (designers/artworkers) based remotely in different offices in Europe with an empathetic, growth-oriented approach.

  • Production Scope: Broad familiarity managing workflows across digital performance, multi-market localization, physical/virtual events, AI creative production, and employer branding.

  • Culture Driver: Thrives in a peer environment working alongside other motivated and constructive senior PMs, producers, creatives, and strategists.

  • Operational Skills: Mastery of modern project management tooling and AI-powered workflows (e.g. Asana, Notion, Jira, Slack).

  • Project Management Experience: Strong hands-on project management experience in a fast-paced, delivery-focused environment, running multiple projects concurrently. Comfortable not just initiating projects, but staying a consistent presence throughout: managing delivery, and reassessing priorities and capacity as needs shift.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love day-to-day production and get a kick out of turning an event brief into finished collateral within a week.

  • You want to build how a studio works, from intake to resourcing, as much as you want to ship the work.

  • You prefer a predictable, planned workload. Last-minute requests are part of life on Brand.

  • You haven't line-managed people yet. Direct people management of the studio team is a core part of this role.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Deliver the studio's day-to-day work to our speed and quality standards, in line with the new brand guidelines.

  • Set best practice for how the studio takes in, briefs, tracks and resources work.

  • Improve how we estimate and plan capacity, using AI where it makes sense.

The location

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  • Hiring manager interview: A conversation with the Director about the projects you've delivered, the teams you've led and the kind of production work you enjoy most.

  • Case study: You'll walk us through how you'd approach a creative production task. You'll present to the Director and a peer project lead, and possibly a member of the studio team.

  • Final stage: Team-fit chat with one or two people from the studio

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired this role, we received an incredibly high volume of applications but only so many could be taken forward. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

You’ll be part of the Direct Hotels team, reporting to the Head of Product for Supply Platform. Working closely with Engineering, Design, Commercial, Operations and Analytics to build capabilities for hotel partners that support our broader supply strategy. The team sits within Platform, which provides shared technology and tools to help teams across loveholidays deliver the outcomes that drive value for our suppliers and experiences that delight our customers.

Your day-to-day:

  • Own the product direction and roadmap. Translate the Direct Hotels ambition into prioritised opportunities, clear outcomes and achievable delivery increments. Make informed trade-offs between supplier needs, commercial value and technical investment.

  • Understand the people using our products. Work directly with hotel partners, contracting teams and loading operations to uncover problems, test ideas and understand what will drive adoption.

  • Take products from discovery through to measurable impact. Work closely with Engineering and Design to prototype, test, deliver and iterate. Explore practical applications of AI, define success measures and use evidence from adoption, supplier feedback and commercial performance to guide what comes next.

Your skillset:

  • Product ownership and strategic delivery: A track record of taking complex problems from discovery through to delivery and demonstrating meaningful user and business outcomes. The ability to connect a long-term vision to the next useful improvement, navigate uncertainty and drive delivery.

Experience defining success measures, investigating performance and using data alongside qualitative research to make decisions.

  • Communication and technical fluency: Clear communication and the ability to align commercial, operational and technical colleagues around priorities, decisions and outcomes. Comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, data and platform constraints with Engineering.

At loveholidays, we focus on creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed. We value the different perspectives, experiences and ideas each person brings, because they help us work better together, challenge our thinking and make stronger decisions.

Bouw mee aan het cloudplatform waarop heel Univé draait.

Wie ben jij

Jij bent een ervaren Product Owner die strategisch denken combineert met technische diepgang.

  • Minimaal 3–5 jaar ervaring als Product Owner in een complexe IT omgeving.

  • Je beheerst de volledige product lifecycle.

  • Sterk in stakeholdermanagement en besluitvaardig in complexe domeinen.

  • Begrip van landing zones, networking, identity, CI/CD, security baselines.

  • Kunt technische afhankelijkheden doorgronden en vertalen naar backlogitems.

  • Kennis van cloud governance, FinOps, compliance en platformprincipes.

  • Ervaring met aansturen van externe partners (zoals MSP).

  • Je brengt structuur in multidisciplinaire samenwerking.

  • Ervaring met Agile (Scrum/SAFe), story slicing, acceptance criteria.

  • Sterke schriftelijke en visuele communicatieskills voor roadmap en value cases.

  • HBO/WO niveau, bij voorkeur in IT of bedrijfskunde.

  • Continue verbeter mindset en plezier in rol als challenger en verbinder.

Wat ga je doen

Als Product Owner van het CCC ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen business, productteams, architectuur, security en de MSP. Jij vertaalt de visie naar waardevolle platformdiensten, bepaalt prioriteiten op basis van risico, waarde en technische haalbaarheid, en zorgt dat het cloudplatform continu doorontwikkeld wordt. Je combineert strategische keuzes met voldoende technische diepgang om te begrijpen wát er nodig is voor een state‑of‑the‑art cloudomgeving — en waarom.
 

Jouw rol
 

Als Product Owner binnen het CCC:

  • geef je richting aan de doorontwikkeling van het Univé‑cloudplatform op basis van de CCC‑visie en het Cloud Capability Model;

  • werk je nauw samen met architectuur, security en de MSP om standaarden, kaders en guardrails te definiëren en te bewaken;

  • zorg je voor een scherpe, realistische en waarde‑gedreven roadmap voor platformdiensten, automatisering, beveiliging en landing zones;

  • maak je keuzes die bijdragen aan standaardisatie, toekomstbestendigheid en veilige autonomie van productteams;

  • prioriteer je de backlog in balans tussen innovatie, betrouwbaarheid, vervolgtechniek en compliance;

  • fungeer je als sparringpartner voor engineers, architecten en de MSP;

  • borg je dat nieuwe cloudcapaciteiten voldoen aan ontwerpprincipes, governance‑richtlijnen en security‑eisen;

  • stimuleer je kennisdeling en samenwerking binnen Univé. 

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden


Strategie & Roadmap

  • vertalen van de CCC‑visie naar een concrete productstrategie;

  • opstellen en bewaken van de roadmap voor platformdiensten, automatisering, landing zones en PaaS‑diensten;

Samenwerking & Regie

  • voeren van regie op de MSP en bewaken van kwaliteit, volwassenheid en doorontwikkeling;

  • afstemmen met architectuur, security, servicemanagement en productteams;

Techniek & Inhoud

  • begrijpen van centrale cloudcomponenten zoals landing zones, netwerken, security‑baselines, automatisering en containerplatformen;

  • doorvertalen van technische kaders naar backlogitems;

Governance & Kwaliteit

  • waarborgen van compliance, standaardisatie en veilige cloudadoptie binnen Univé;

  • monitoren van platformprestaties en servicekwaliteit. 

Wat bieden wij

  • een sleutelrol binnen het Cloud Competence Center;

  • ruimte om te pionieren en professionaliseren;

  • afwisseling tussen architectuur en hands‑on engineering;

  • collega’s die voor kwaliteit en eenvoud gaan;

  • een moderne omgeving waar cloud, automatisering en security topprioriteit zijn

Bij Univé IT bieden we je een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische organisatie. De salarisrange ligt tussen € 64.830,24 en € 93.155,08 bruto per jaar op basis van een 38-urige werk-week (inclusief vakantiegeld, een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning).

De belangrijkste arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rijtje:

 

  • je krijgt een prima salaris, afhankelijk van je opleiding, ervaring en competenties;

  • 13e maand;

  • 8% vakantiegeld variabele Collectieve Prestatie Beloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris;

  • arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd;

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek;

  • goede studiekostenregeling;

  • prima pensioenvoorziening;

  • reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding;

  • en natuurlijk: korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.

Het team heeft een fijne werkplek in Zwolle, vlakbij het station. In overleg met het team behoort 2-3 dagen thuiswerken tot de mogelijkheden. 

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dicht bij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren in een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platform-organisatie. 

Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé.  

Drie focusgebieden 
 

De IT-organisatie is  ingericht met drie primaire afdelingen op de focusgebieden Kern, Data en Distributie. De CIO Office biedt ondersteuning door richting en houvast te geven aan strategische doelen en kaders. De afdeling IT Kern levert een state of the art IT-fundament voor de Univé-organisatie om de businessdoelen te realiseren: betrouwbaar en efficiënt en met een perfecte performance. De afdeling IT Kern bestaat uit vier teams:
 

  • Services – werkplekdiensten, 1e lijns gebruikersondersteuning, Proces- & Servicemanagement en consultancy

  • Frontend Platform – applicatiemanagement van platformen die vooral het contact met onze leden ondersteunen zoals onze online omgeving, CRM en telefonie

  • Backend Platform – applicatiemanagement van platformen die vooral ‘de achterkant processen’ ondersteunen zoals de polis-, claim- en financiële administratie

  • Infra & Security Platform – Cloud Competence Center en operationele security activiteiten

Binnen Infra en Security Platform zijn we op zoek naar een Cloud Specialist voor het Cloud Competence Center die ons verder helpt de professionalisering van ons cloudlandschap te realiseren.
 

Het Cloud Competence Center (CCC) binnen Univé is dé centrale plek waar cloudexpertise, innovatiekracht en toekomstbestendige standaarden samenkomen. Vanuit dit regie‑ en kenniscentrum ondersteunen wij de hele organisatie bij veilig, efficiënt en schaalbaar cloudgebruik. Om onze ambities verder vorm te geven, zoeken wij een veelzijdige Cloud Specialist — een professional die zich thuis voelt in een multidisciplinaire rol en energie krijgt van zowel strategisch ontwerpen als hands‑on realiseren.

jobs.title: Product Manager - CDI
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

 

Notre mission

 

Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation.

⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation. Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement”

👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 !

💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux !

 

Le mot de la CEO

“Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs.
Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon

 

Et ce poste alors ?

 

Le rôle

Nous recherchons notre Founding Marketing Manager pour construire le moteur d'acquisition et de notoriété de Solteo. Premier recrutement marketing de l'entreprise, tu pars d'une page presque blanche : stratégie, canaux, budget et marque sont à construire, en lien direct avec Manon (CEO).

Ton objectif : générer un flux régulier de leads qualifiés pour l'équipe commerciale, à un coût d'acquisition maîtrisé, et faire de Solteo une référence de l'électrification des bâtiments auprès des installateurs. Tu accompagneras aussi le lancement de nos nouvelles offres.

 

Missions et responsabilités

Tu prendras la responsabilité d'un périmètre produit de bout en bout : comprendre les problèmes de nos utilisateurs, identifier les meilleures opportunités, concevoir et cadrer les solutions avec l'équipe, les amener jusqu'en production et mesurer leur impact.

Nous cherchons surtout quelqu'un de très autonome, pragmatique et à l'aise dans un environnement startup, où tout n'est pas toujours parfaitement défini et où il faut savoir avancer, arbitrer et mettre les mains dans le cambouis.

  1. Discovery continue

Tu développes une compréhension fine de nos utilisateurs, de leurs usages et de leurs irritants. Tu combines échanges terrain, retours des équipes et analyse des données pour identifier et prioriser les opportunités à plus fort impact.

  1. Shaping & conception

Tu transformes des problèmes parfois encore flous en sujets bien cadrés et en solutions simples. Tu es capable de matérialiser rapidement une idée à travers des parcours, wireframes ou prototypes, et de la challenger avec les utilisateurs et l'équipe.

  1. Delivery & impact

Tu travailles étroitement avec les développeurs pour amener les sujets jusqu'en production, sans perdre de vue le problème initial. Une fois les fonctionnalités livrées, tu mesures leur adoption et leur impact pour comprendre ce qui fonctionne — ou non — et continuer à itérer.

  1. Ownership & autonomie

Tu n'attends pas que quelqu'un découpe précisément ton travail. Lorsque tu identifies un problème important, tu cherches à le comprendre, tu impliques les bonnes personnes et tu fais avancer le sujet.

 

Tes objectifs:

⭐ Les 30 premiers jours — Comprendre

Ton premier objectif sera d'absorber un maximum de contexte : le produit Solteo, nos utilisateurs et leurs métiers, le marché photovoltaïque, notre fonctionnement Produit & Tech et nos principaux enjeux business.

Tu participeras rapidement à des échanges avec nos clients et commenceras à travailler sur de vrais sujets produit.

🎯 Objectif : comprendre qui sont nos utilisateurs, comment ils utilisent Solteo, leurs principaux problèmes et les enjeux derrière notre roadmap.

⭐ De 1 à 3 mois — Prendre en main ton périmètre

Tu prendras progressivement la responsabilité d'un périmètre produit. Tu mèneras tes propres investigations, participeras au shaping des sujets, concevras les solutions avec l'équipe et suivras leur livraison.

🎯 Objectif : mener de manière autonome un sujet produit, de la compréhension du problème jusqu'à sa mise en production.

⭐ De 3 à 12 mois — Devenir pleinement autonome

Tu pilotes ton périmètre avec beaucoup d'autonomie : comprendre les problèmes, identifier les opportunités, définir les priorités, construire les bons sujets avec l'équipe et mesurer leur impact.

🎯 Objectif : être pleinement responsable de l'impact produit de ton périmètre et contribuer activement à faire évoluer notre manière de construire le produit.

 

Les compétences qu’on recherche

 

  • Tu as 3+ ans d'expérience en Product Management, idéalement sur un produit SaaS B2B.

  • Tu es à l'aise dans un environnement start-up : le flou ne te paralyse pas et tu sais avancer sans avoir toutes les réponses.

  • Tu as un bon sens produit et UX et sais transformer un problème complexe en une solution simple.

  • Tu es à l'aise aussi bien avec les utilisateurs qu'avec les équipes techniques.

  • Tu sais utiliser la donnée pour challenger tes intuitions et mesurer l'impact de ce que tu construis.

  • Tu es autonome, curieux·se et pragmatique : quand il faut creuser un sujet ou mettre les mains dans le cambouis, tu le fais.

 

Ce qui serait un plus

Tu n'as pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases, mais on sera particulièrement intéressés si :

  • tu as déjà évolué dans une startup ou scale-up SaaS B2B avec une forte culture d'exécution ;

  • tu sais utiliser PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude ou un outil similaire ;

  • tu sais écrire des requêtes SQL pour explorer toi-même les données ;

  • tu as utilisé des outils no-code / low-code pour prototyper, automatiser ou tester rapidement une idée ;

  • tu te débrouilles sur Figma et Claude Code (ou Codex), sans être Product designer ou développeur.

  • tu as une expérience avec des logiciels métiers complexes ;

  • tu as déjà travaillé avec des artisans, des indépendants ou des professionnels du BTP ;

  • tu connais ou as déjà utilisé Shape Up — sinon, pas de panique, ça s'apprend vite ;

  • tu t'intéresses au secteur de l'énergie et à la transition énergétique ;

  • tu connais la différence entre un kWc et un kWh.

Mais Solteo c’est aussi…

  • Un cadre professionnel vivant et énergique, où la prise d’initiatives est non seulement appréciée mais également récompensée.

  • La chance de parfaire et d'enrichir tes connaissances dans un secteur en pleine croissance et qui a du sens.

  • Des bureaux situés en plein centre de Paris, avec plusieurs autres start-ups du solaire

  • Une diversité de projets captivants, offrant l'opportunité de collaborer avec des clients diverses et variés. Pas possible de s’ennuyer !

Nous te promettons aussi une ambiance d’équipe bienveillante, accueillante et stimulante. Et bien sûr, plein d’évènements d’équipe !

 

Processus de recrutement

  • 📞 Entretien de cadrage au téléphone (20 min) : pour discuter de ton CV et des attentes sur le poste.

  • 🤝 Entretien de fit en visio (45 min) : pour faire connaissance, discuter de ton parcours et de tes motivations avec un Co-fondateur et le COO (Mehdi).

  • 🎯 Entretien technique avec l’équipe commerciale (1h00) : mise en situation pratique sur un business case avec le Head of Product et le COO ou PM.

  • 🕵️‍♂️ Prise de références (Réf call).

  • 🍽️ Déjeuner d’équipe : rencontre conviviale avec les fondateurs et toute l'équipe Solteo.

 

Détails du poste

  • CDI - temps Plein

  • Paris 17e

  • Prise de poste: dès que possible

  • Rémunération : 45k€ – 55k€, selon expérience

About us

Zenjob is an AI-powered flexible staffing platform that has connected companies and temporary workers since 2015. Companies use our platform to book ready-to-work staff in real time, while students use our app - we call them Zenjobbers - to find part-time jobs that conveniently fit around their studies. Over 40,000 Zenjobbers and 1,000 partner companies from logistics, retail, and hospitality in all major German cities share our belief that good work is not a coincidence. It is the result of innovative technology and genuine commitment. Good work starts here.

The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Manager to join our team. In this role, you will play a key part in defining and executing a product vision that ensures Zenjob’s marketplace dynamics are well balanced, by optimizing our demand forecast, making sure jobs and Zenjobbers are matched optimally, and engaging students in working a high number of shifts.

This is not a role that owns one squad's backlog. You'll work project-based: form a team around a problem, own it end-to-end until it delivers on the expected need. You'll get problem statements, not requirements documents. Recent examples: how shifts get allocated across thousands of Zenjobbers each week, and how we get a new Zenjobber from signup to their first shift without human intervention.

This role suits a Product Manager who is energised by an open-ended problem, and who finds complex workflows genuinely interesting. You'll report to the Director of Product and work across our Supply, Demand and Staffing squads, depending on the problem to solve.

What You’ll do

  • Bring our business goals to reality. Understand our financial goals, our users' problems and transform them into solutions that drive our revenue up.

  • Talk to users directly. Zenjobbers, clients, and our own internal teams. Most of the good opportunities come out of these conversations, not out of a backlog.

  • Do your own data work. You don’t wait until a data analyst gives you the insights, you dive into it and derive them yourself.

  • Turn ambiguity into a defensible plan. Take a problem nobody agrees on yet, and define what we're solving, what we're explicitly not solving, and in what order.

  • Design and run tests. Form a hypothesis, define what would falsify it, ship the smallest thing that gives you a real answer, and be honest about the result.

  • Drive product development from concept to launch. Pull together Engineering, Design, Ops and Commercial around a problem and keep them moving through hypothesis, building, rollout and post-launch decision making

  • Own the outcome, not the output. Each project has a number attached. You define what success looks like up front, and you're the one who says whether it was hit.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

Pelico is seeking a Lead AI Product Manager to pioneer our agent-first product strategy in Paris. You'll define and build the next generation of autonomous AI agents that transform how aerospace and manufacturing companies plan, optimize, and execute complex supply chain operations. This is a unique opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI in enterprise B2B, creating intelligent systems that make decisions, take actions, and deliver measurable business value autonomously.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product vision and execution for autonomous AI agents — define agent architectures, multi-agent systems, and agentic workflows that transform supply chain planning, inventory optimization, production scheduling, and MRO operations

  • Lead complex cross-functional AI initiatives — drive discovery of high-value use cases, design agent personas and reasoning patterns, and pioneer agent-native UX paradigms including conversational interfaces and proactive recommendations

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, customer operations, sales, and enterprise customers to ensure AI features deliver measurable value and achieve adoption at scale

  • Define the AI product vision and strategic roadmap with VP Product and engineering leadership, balancing innovation with enterprise deployment requirements around scalability, explainability, security, and compliance

  • Drive excellence in AI product development — from experimentation frameworks to deployment best practices — championing data-driven decision making and rapid iteration to launch capabilities that deliver 10x productivity improvements to enterprise customers

About You

  • 5+ years in product management with 3+ years building AI/ML products, including hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, autonomous agents, or intelligent automation in Enterprise B2B SaaS

  • Strong technical acumen across agent architectures — including multi-agent systems, LLM-based reasoning, tool use, RAG, RLHF, and safety mechanisms — to collaborate effectively with ML engineers and data scientists

  • Proven track record shipping autonomous AI products to large enterprise customers, with experience navigating safety, compliance, auditability, and controlled autonomy requirements

  • Outstanding communication skills in English and French — able to articulate complex agentic AI concepts to executives, engineers, and end users alike

  • You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work — curious about what’s possible and quick to adopt new ways of working smarter and faster.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows — whether for writing, research, analysis, coding, or productivity — and a genuine interest in staying at the frontier of what these tools can do.

  • Experience building agent-based products with frameworks like LangChain, AutoGPT, CrewAI, or custom agent architectures

  • Background in operations research, supply chain, manufacturing, or aerospace industries

Why Pelico

We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:

  • Meaningful equity — you're building this with us, so you'll own a piece of it

  • Competitive salary benchmarked to your market

  • Flexible, hybrid work model — we care about output, not face time

  • Alan health coverage — up to 70% covered by Pelico

  • Learning & development budget — we invest in people who invest in themselves

  • Transport: 50% public transit coverage or equivalent sustainable mobility package

  • Empowered Culture: High trust, flat hierarchies, and an environment where your decisions directly shape the product.

Not ticking every box?

Not ticking every box? We encourage you to apply anyway! We know great talent doesn’t always follow a checklist and we care more about your potential, curiosity, and motivation to learn.

At ACCURIDS, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented backgrounds in tech, science, and data to apply.

Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. We deliver personalized ads that drive users to install an app or re-engage with one they've stopped using.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a Swiss data and AI consulting company helping organisations in traditional industries solve complex challenges in areas such as operations, finance, manufacturing and R&D. We work at the intersection of technology and business, delivering data and AI solutions that create practical value for our clients.

Our teams have delivered projects across industries including automotive, chemicals, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We are a Palantir partner and work with clients across the full data and AI journey, from understanding a business problem to building and deploying the solution.

Unit8 has delivered more than 300 projects and grown to a team of 190+ talented people across ten office locations. Following our growth across Europe and our expansion into North America, we are now building our presence in the United Arab Emirates. We are looking for a Palantir Foundry Engineer to join us in Abu Dhabi. This role is based in the UAE and includes relocation from Switzerland with full immigration and relocation support.

Requirements

About the Role

As one of the first members of Unit8’s team in the UAE, you will help deliver Foundry solutions for clients while contributing to the growth of our presence in the region.

You will work directly with client teams to understand their data and operational challenges, then design and build solutions that address them. The role combines hands-on engineering with close collaboration across business and technical teams. You will also contribute your technical perspective during early client discussions and help shape practical approaches to new opportunities.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, deploy and maintain data solutions using Palantir Foundry.
  • Develop and troubleshoot data pipelines and processing systems using Foundry and relevant open-source or proprietary technologies.
  • Build and maintain Foundry components such as Ontologies, pipelines, and user-facing applications.
  • Apply sound engineering practices for testing, data quality, performance, security and maintainability.
  • Work with client stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify problems and translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product owners and client teams in an agile environment.
  • Contribute to technical discovery and solution scoping for prospective and ongoing engagements.
  • Help establish Unit8’s engineering and delivery approach in the UAE, sharing knowledge with colleagues and supporting the growth of the local team.

About You

We are looking for an experienced Palantir Foundry Engineer with a passion for data and solving complex client challenges. You should be a skilled professional who has:

* Foundry Platform Knowledge

    • Demonstrated experience with AIP, Workshop, Code repository, and Pipeline Builder.
    • A solid understanding of security concepts within Foundry, including restricted views and markings.
    • Knowledge of Ontology and Data connection.
    • We're interested in the technical details of what you've built and how you approached the architecture of your Foundry use-cases.

* Programming Skills - proficiency in Python and PySpark.

* Data Skills (Nice-to-have) - knowledge of data modeling and basic concepts of data science (classification, clustering, regression).

* Professional Experience

  • A minimum of 1 year of experience working with the Foundry platform, ideally within a larger company where you may have had a focused but deep exposure.
  • Strong client-facing skills: You are comfortable interacting with both business and technical clients, giving presentations, and possess a strong problem-solving mindset.

* Other

  • You are willing to travel to meet with our clients and the team

Benefits

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to help establish Unit8’s presence in a new market.
  • Hands-on work on client challenges with tangible business impact.
  • Exposure to different industries, projects and technologies.
  • A collaborative team environment with colleagues across Switzerland, Europe and North America.
  • Mentorship and opportunities to develop your technical and consulting skills.
  • Full immigration support for your move to the UAE.
  • Relocation support, including accommodation and travel allowances.
  • Opportunities to contribute to knowledge sharing and projects with a positive impact.

jobs.description:
As we continue to scale, we are looking for a Senior Project Manager, who wants to drive real impact, taking products from concept to deployment.

At Optics11, we build advanced sensing technology that helps protect what matters most, from critical offshore energy infrastructure to underwater security systems. Our solutions operate in complex, high-stakes environments where precision, reliability, and real-world performance are essential.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of New Product Introduction (NPI) and Field Integration, ensuring that what is developed by engineering teams can successfully operate in real-world, often offshore environments. You will play a key role in bridging the gap between development and deployment. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role in a fast-moving scale-up, where not everything is fully defined. You will need to balance structure with pragmatism, make decisions with incomplete information, and keep projects moving despite changing priorities.

What you will do

  • Lead end-to-end projects covering product delivery (hardware and software) and field integration, including offshore deployment

  • Coordinate across engineering, operations, supply chain, and external partners to ensure smooth execution

  • Translate ambiguous goals and requirements into clear, actionable plans

  • Drive momentum and remove blockers in fast-moving, real-world environments

  • Support bid preparation by building realistic timelines and execution strategies, even with limited information

  • Identify gaps in ways of working and proactively improve processes across teams

  • Enable a learning-oriented project environment by sharing best practices and coaching others

  • Establish feedback loops between R&D and field teams to improve product and execution quality

What’s in it for you

  • Work on products that are deployed in real-world, high-impact environments, not just concepts or internal tools

  • Operate in a fast-growing, international scale-up where you can truly influence how projects are run

  • Regular team activities and shared lunches throughout the week


What we are looking for

  • 5–8 years of project management experience in a technical environment

  • MSc degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Physics, or a related field

  • Hands-on experience with New Product Introduction (NPI) projects is essential

  • Proven track record of delivering projects with real-world execution (not only planning)

  • Comfortable combining structured planning with hands-on operational involvement

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think in a structured way

  • Experience with offshore or field deployment projects is a strong plus

  • Able to make decisions and move forward with incomplete information

  • Clear communicator who can align technical (R&D) and operational (field) teams

De verbindende schakel zijn tussen klanten, business en softwareontwikkeling én bijdragen aan innovatieve softwareoplossingen die gemeenten, belastingsamenwerkingen en waterschappen helpen om hun dienstverlening continu te verbeteren? Als Product Owner ben jij de verbindende factor tussen onze klanten en het ontwikkelteam. Bij de ene klant ligt een plan al klaar en bij de andere klant help jij om de behoefte en mogelijkheden te ontdekken. Jij stelt de juiste vragen, denkt mee over processen en zoekt samen met de klant naar de oplossing die écht waarde toevoegt. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces. Samen met het team zorg je ervoor dat klantwensen worden vertaald naar concrete functionaliteiten en kwalitatieve software. Daarbij combineer je adviesvaardigheden, proceskennis en affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling.

Wat doe je nog meer?

  • Je adviseert klanten over procesverbetering en digitale oplossingen.

Dit krijg je

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer van € 0,23 netto per kilometer óf een NS Businesscard

  • Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken

  • Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee

Je bent enthousiast, nieuwsgierig en denkt graag in mogelijkheden. Je krijgt energie van complexe vraagstukken, klantcontact en het creëren van slimme oplossingen. Je bent communicatief sterk, overtuigend en weet verschillende belangen met elkaar te verbinden.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • Kennis van bedrijfsprocessen en ervaring met procesoptimalisatie.

  • Een commerciële instelling en oog voor nieuwe kansen.

  • Een proactieve houding, eigenaarschap en het vermogen om snel te schakelen.

Je voelt je thuis in een organisatie waar ruimte is voor eigen initiatief, waar samenwerking centraal staat en waar je samen met klanten en collega’s werkt aan oplossingen die er écht toe doen.

Multiverse builds AI products for the future of work, and we want our own People team to run on the same principles we sell to customers. jobs.description:
About Peec AI

Peec AI is a Berlin-based Series A startup building analytics and intelligence tools for modern SEO and growth teams. As AI reshapes how people discover information online, companies need new ways to understand where they appear, how they perform, and where the next growth opportunities lie. Peec AI helps teams track their visibility across AI search, measure performance, and uncover opportunities to grow their organic presence in an increasingly complex search landscape.

About the role

We're looking for a second Product Marketing Manager to help shape how Peec AI shows up in the world. You'll work side by side with our founding PMM, who sets the positioning and messaging foundation, and your job is to make that foundation work everywhere it needs to: in a sales pitch, a customer conversation, a launch, a competitive deal. You'll work closely with Growth, Product, Sales, and CX, turning what Peec does into stories and materials that customers understand and teams actually use.

What you'll do

  • Work with our founding PMM to sharpen and evolve positioning and messaging, and own how it gets applied across segments, use cases, and conversations so every audience hears a narrative that is sharp, specific, and credible

  • Get deep into the product and stay exceptionally close to customers, turning that proximity into insight that’s reflected in everything we say.

  • Turn product launches and the ongoing drumbeat of releases into the materials teams need to explain and sell them: pitch narratives, decks, one-pagers, battlecards, and demo stories.

  • Make sure what we create gets used: train Sales and CX teams, join customer calls, see what works in real conversations, and fix what doesn’t.

  • Run win/loss and buyer research with Sales and CX, and turn what you hear into findings that shape our messaging and inform the roadmap.

  • Build and maintain competitive intelligence in a category that moves weekly, keeping the team clear-eyed on what is real and what is noise.

  • Refine our ICP and segment definitions, bringing what you learn from the field into how we talk about who we serve.

What we're looking for

  • You write with a point of view and hold your opinions loosely. Your drafts argue for something, and you change your mind when the evidence says to.

  • You’re exceptionally curious about the product, the category, and especially the customer. You ask good questions, listen carefully, and spot things others miss.

  • You get technical products. You can explain an analytics tool clearly, demo it with confidence, and hold your own with a technical buyer.

  • You take ownership, bring your own ideas, and are as comfortable leading projects as you are running with someone else’s brief.

  • 4+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, with a demonstrated history of working with sales and enablement teams.

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate, and excited to be in the office five days a week.

Bonus Points

  • Background in an adjacent category: SEO tooling, analytics, developer tools, MarTech, or brand monitoring

  • Public writing track record: posts, essays, conference talks, podcast appearances

  • A personal on-camera or public-speaking track record (YouTube, keynotes, podcast hosting, webinars)

  • Deep interest in AI and how it is reshaping how people find, evaluate, and trust information

  • Experience at a fast-growing, venture-backed startup where product marketing worked closely with a scaling sales team

  • Regular team events and off-sites

  • Aggressive equity compensation package

  • Paid meal and Uber home when working late

  • A beautiful office space and work environment in Berlin or New York
