Product Manager - Trust & Safety (Full Remote - Germany)
jobs.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.

You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.

This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol. You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.

Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.

Here’s what you can expect:

Key Responsibilities

  • Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

  • Internally developed moderation technologies. Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

  • Third-party safety partnerships and integrations. Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

  • Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance. Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

  • Red teaming and adversarial testing. Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

  • Trust and safety reviews for new features. Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.

  • Incident follow-through and continuous improvement. Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.

Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub.

Your Qualifications

  • Data-driven product decisions that align with legal/ethical standards: You can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next. You can assess risks associated with user-generated content, transactions, and interactions, and translate these into policies that align with legal and ethical standards, trackers/dashboards, and strategic planning;

  • Content moderation and AI guardrails: You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting.

  • Legal/safety work experience: You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product;

  • Collaborative mindset and communication: You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams — these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent and comfortable in English;

  • AI fluency: You are completely comfortable working with and leveraging AI tools. You actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;

  • You are point person for third-party partnerships: You proactively test and can autonomously handle discussions with third-party tools and integrations that affect our compliance and safety posture;

  • You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: Comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process;

  • You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content;

Bonus points

  • You have previous legal/compliance education

  • Professional experience or interest in AI

  • Experience with consumer-facing features, particularly in the entertainment or gaming industry

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable reviewing and discussing uncensored AI-generated content and NSFW material

We believe strongly that information can be learned, but effort and motivation cannot. If this role appeals to you but you don’t have hands-on experience in all the fields listed in this job description, apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a good fit!

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Compensation: $95K – $125K

  • • Annual Compensation Range (Gross) $95K – $125K

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology powers some of the UK’s most ambitious and forward-thinking banks, fintechs, financial advisers and wealth firms, giving them the software and services they need to launch and grow investment propositions at pace.

We’ve grown rapidly to reach the scale of some of the UK’s largest investment platforms. Today, more than one million people – around 5% of UK investors – rely on Seccl to power their investment experience. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, a group with a track record of using technology to transform established industries. Our sister company, Octopus Energy, has grown from a UK start-up into a global energy and technology business, while its now-demerged Kraken platform supports tens of millions of accounts around the world. We share that ambition to use better technology to transform an industry – replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for the future.

Like Octopus, we’re a B Corp-certified company, with a firm belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand. If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

You’ll join our strategic delivery team, reporting to our head of strategic delivery, and lead some of Seccl’s biggest and most complex programmes. These could include managing our entry to new markets, overseeing the onboarding of major new customers, tackling significant re-platforming projects or launching new operating models.

You’ll take responsibility for a programme end to end – turning a strategic or commercial objective into a workable plan, bringing together the right people from across Seccl and driving the decisions needed to get it delivered.

You’ll work across the business – collaborating with our product, engineering, operations, commercial, risk and finance teams, as well as directly with senior stakeholders at our customer firms. These programmes will be of significant commercial value and come with real complexity, so you’ll need to build strong relationships, make difficult calls and know when something genuinely needs escalating.

What you’ll be accountable for...

You will:

  • Own complex strategic programmes end to end, from business case and mobilisation through to launch, migration and handover

  • Build the business case, delivery plan, team and governance needed to get a programme moving

  • Lead cross-functional delivery across Product, Engineering, Operations, Commercial, Risk, Finance and other teams

  • Drive decisions and resolve blockers, while managing risks, dependencies, scope, cost and timelines

  • Lead commercial discussions with customer firms where needed, working closely with Commercial and Legal

  • Run readiness and go/no-go decisions, then closing programmes against their original business case

This role’s for you if...

  • You have a background in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry and understand the complexity that comes with delivering significant change

  • You have experience leading large, complex programmes (such as major re-platforming or new market expansion), and understand the complexities and inter-dependencies involved

  • You’ve independently led complex, high-stakes programmes from start to finish, with accountability for delivery

  • You’re comfortable creating direction and structure where there isn’t an existing playbook, and solving problems as they emerge

  • You build strong relationships and collaborate well across teams, while being confident enough to challenge, hold people to account and make difficult decisions

  • You understand both delivery and the commercial case behind it, including cost, value and trade-offs

  • You’re strong at cross-functional dependency and risk management and know when to make the call yourself

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You want a ready-made playbook. You’ll often need to create the structure and delivery approach yourself

  • You prefer a narrow programme management remit. This role works across the business and gets into commercial and strategic decisions

  • You’re quick to escalate difficult decisions. We’ll expect you to use your judgement and operate with a high level of autonomy

  • You’d rather avoid customer-facing commercial conversations. Some programmes will involve working directly with senior customer stakeholders

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 A salary of £85,000-£115,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 £750 annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

  • First stage: an initial discussion around your relevant experience and how you work with the hiring manager and another strategic delivery lead

  • Second stage: role-specific assessment with the hiring manager and chief product officer

  • Final stage: a bar raiser interview with our chief technology officer

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Business Consultant - Marketing Automation
Senior Design Systems Designer
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

What you'll do

Suitcase is Perk's design system, supporting 25+ designers and the engineers who build with them across web and mobile. Our ambition is for it to be a complete, consumer-grade, accessible and distributable system, so Perk feels like one consistent product on every surface our customers use, including AI agents and assistants. As a Senior Design Systems Designer you'll own the craft and visual direction of Suitcase, and work with front-end engineers, content designers and product designers to make high quality design the default standard. You will:

  • Set the direction for Suitcase with design and engineering leadership, turn the vision into a roadmap with named resources, and report progress against it.

  • Own the visual language, token architecture, and foundations of Suitcase: typography, colour, space, motion, and interaction states.

  • Work with content design and localisation on content tokens, so components carry their language requirements.

  • Design, document, and refine components with complete states, variants, platform coverage and usage guidance.

  • Write component specs that AI prototyping tools can read, so generated prototypes use real Suitcase components and tokens.

  • Bring components to WCAG 2.2 AA, and make conformance part of how new components are built and reviewed.

  • Define adoption, component health, accessibility, and Figma-to-code parity measures with engineering, and report against them.

  • Run the contribution governance model, with defined routes for components between an experimental layer and the core system.

  • Champion Suitcase across Builders, explain the reasoning behind decisions, and coach designers and engineers on using and contributing to the system.

What you'll need

  • Strong product design experience, including time spent designing and scaling design systems for a fast-growing product on web and mobile.

  • A deep grasp of typography, colour, layout, motion, and micro-interactions.

  • Judgement on when the system needs a new component and when an existing one should be used.

  • Experience designing and maintaining token systems, including naming, theming, documentation, and Figma-to-code workflows, and working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

  • Practical experience designing components for WCAG 2.2 AA standards, including keyboard and screen-reader behaviour.

  • Experience prototyping with AI tools and with Storybook, Code Connect and MCP tooling, and an understanding of how they connect design systems to code and AI tools.

  • The ability to take non-designers from the problem to the decision to the outcome and build adoption by persuasion.

  • A clear opinion of what good looks like, and the ability to make trade-off decisions and defend them.

  • Experience using customer insight from research, support and sales as well as team data, and taking ownership of business outcomes.

  • A clear voice in shaping roadmap, sequencing and scope, and the ability to push back, including when the system is being bypassed, without damaging the relationship.

  • Experience integrating or consolidating design systems.

  • Familiarity with content and localisation considerations in components.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • A track record of moving growth and adoption metrics through the products you’ve shipped

jobs.title: Product Manager — Kits and Integrated Workflows
jobs.description:
At ONI, we are driven by a profound mission: to propel scientific discovery and combat diseases by granting everyone the ability to visualize, comprehend, and share the intricate microscopic details of life. Our revolutionary Nanoimager and Aplo Platform stand at the forefront of advancing cellular studies on a molecular level, making substantial contributions to the evolution of scientific knowledge. 

We’re looking for a product manager to own our kits and workflows, including EV Profiler and LNP Profiler, now that the concept is proven. You’ll make sure sample preparation, fluid handling, imaging, analysis and reporting software work together as one system, and your responsibility is the complete customer experience, from sample to scientifically meaningful result. The job is making that system rock solid: hardening what’s already on the market, making sure it works the same way at every site, and getting more customers on it without support load growing at the same rate. 


The Role

As part of the Product team, you’ll own the product management of our kits and end-to-end workflows, including the Discovery Kit, EV Profiler and LNP Profiler and their future revisions. You will ensure these work together with automated sample preparation and fluid handling, imaging, analysis and reporting software to deliver reliable, reproducible and intuitive solutions for our customers.  

The initial products have launched, and the work now is making them dependable, repeatable, and scalable for our customers. You’ll create clarity and momentum for the R&D teams by understanding which problems matter, turning customer and market evidence into priorities, and removing barriers to delivering a coherent solution. You’ll grow adoption to routine use across many sites, including bioprocessing and QC settings where results must be reproducible and defensible, and you’ll work with Marketing on positioning and the product story as the portfolio evolves. You will play a critical role in bringing these quality improvements to the market and ensuring that current and future kits maintain their quality over time, and you’ll help define the roadmap for next iterations of existing and future kits and workflows. As a product manager, you’ll be the connective tissue between software, hardware, bioware, support, and the field, acting as the voice of the customer to help internal teams better understand our customers’ needs and problems.  

The role is ideal for a technically curious, commercially aware individual who loves getting hands-on with products, takes ownership of outcomes and thrives on complex, cross-functional challenges. You will work broadly across our platform and alongside US colleagues; the position is based in Oxford and involves occasional travel to customers and our US team (typically 10-20%). 


What you’ll do

  • Understand scientists and their complete workflows first-hand. Work with customers and field teams, study usage and support data, and synthesize their sometimes conflicting inputs into the problems worth solving. 

  • Drive evidence-led product direction and priorities across our solutions with R&D and commercial leaders, balancing customer outcomes, differentiation, adoption, reliability, margin and technical feasibility. 

  • Own the roadmap for our kits (including the Discovery Kit and the EV and LNP Profiler kits) and workflows, balancing quality, reliability, usability and new features. 

  • Build and refine market and product requirements (MRD/PRD) across workflows, from sample preparation (Aplo Flow) through acquisition (Aplo Scope) to analysis (CODI), according to our Product Development Process. 

  • Own validation for each kit and workflow: define acceptance criteria, performance specifications and validation plans, including reference samples and reproducibility across instruments, operators and sites. Work with R&D, who own development and verification. 

  • Drive coherence across our end-to-end solutions, ensuring kits, reagents, lab automation, instruments and software evolve together rather than as disconnected products. Champion reproducibility, usability and reliable results across the complete workflow. 

  • Connect R&D, operations, quality, service, field applications, sales, marketing and customers. Establish feedback loops, clear ownership and effective cross-team decisions. 

  • Own pricing and packaging for our kits and workflows, balancing customer value, competitiveness and margin targets. 

  • Work with Marketing throughout a product's life to shape positioning, the value proposition and the product story as the portfolio evolves, not only at launch. 

  • Lead launch and release planning with R&D, Marketing and the field: set readiness criteria, make go/no-go decisions, and coordinate documentation, release notes and training for each launch or revision. 

  • Create and run webinars and internal training for the field application and sales teams on new products and revisions, and keep an accurate record of what each kit, instrument and software version can deliver. 

  • Track post-launch performance, including adoption, kit reorders, time to first result, reproducibility, support burden, customer feedback and commercial results, and use it to set priorities. 

  • Analyze support tickets, logs and customer feedback to identify recurring failure modes, and prioritize root-cause fixes into the roadmap. 

  • Work with Quality and Operations on manufacturing transfer, life cycle support and end of life, so our kits and workflows maintain quality over time. 


What you’ll bring

  • A life-science background, ideally EVs, LNPs, nanoparticle characterization, imaging or biophysics. Being able to speak the language of our customers is critical. An MSc/PhD or equivalent hands-on experience is a real plus. 

  • Fluency across software, instruments, laboratory workflows and multidisciplinary R&D; comfortable investigating issues hands-on and understanding how the system fits together. 

  • Experience working with empowered, cross-functional development teams: knowing when to provide context, decide on a trade-off and leave the solution to specialists. 

  • Product management (or product owner) experience in life-science tools or instrumentation, ideally taking something from first release to a scaled, supported product.  

  • Experience planning and running launches with Marketing, R&D and the field, from development through adoption. 

  • Commercial and pricing judgement: You can weigh customer value, competitiveness and margin when setting price and packaging. 

  • A quality mindset: You’re comfortable writing acceptance criteria and test plans, and you think about risk, reproducibility and traceability. Exposure to a quality system (ISO 9001 or 13485) is a plus. 

  • Comfort with data: logs, tickets, precision and method-comparison numbers (CVs, site to site). Evidence sets priorities, not the loudest voice. 

  • The ability to lead across software, hardware, bioware, support and field without owning any of them, and to prioritize when everything feels urgent. 

  • Clear writing and organization skills. Requirements, release notes and docs that other people can act on. 


Nice to have

  • Super-resolution or single-molecule imaging experience (dSTORM, PALM, DNA-PAINT), or general microscopy experience (TIRF, widefield, confocal, spinning-disk). 

  • Hands-on EV or LNP work in research, biopharma, gene therapy or drug delivery. 

  • Laboratory automation, automated liquid handling, sample preparation, consumable kits, workflow integration, scientific software or data analysis. 

  • Integrating instruments, software, consumables and automated lab workflows; exposure to verification, validation, quality systems or lifecycle support. 

  • Commercialization, pricing, segmentation, product positioning or product marketing in technically sophisticated markets. 

At ONI, we understand that a fulfilling career involves more than just challenging work - it's about enjoying a well-rounded experience. When you become a part of our team, you not only contribute to groundbreaking research but also enjoy a range of benefits designed to enhance your life both inside and outside the workplace. 
 
As an equal opportunity employer, we prioritize fairness and respect, ensuring every team member thrives regardless of their background. But that's not all - our perks include:
 
Competitive Compensation We recognise and reward your talent. Enjoy a competitive salary that reflects your expertise and contributions, ensuring your hard work is recognized.
28 days of annual leave plus local bank holidays and 4 dedicated wellbeing days.
Private Healthcare and Dental Coverage: Your health matters to us. Access top-notch medical and dental services, ensuring your well-being is in good hands.
Inclusive Culture: Be a valued member of our diverse, inclusive family. Your unique perspective is celebrated here, fostering a culture of mutual respect and understanding.
Health Assured: Your mental health is essential. Access our comprehensive mental health support services for a balanced work-life experience.
People’s Pension: Secure your future with our pension scheme, investing in your financial well-being beyond the workplace.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Project Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Who are we?

It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks. This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents. All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

What will you do?

As Cybersecurity Project Manager (m/w/d) based in Germany, you will lead the delivery of projects that help protect organisations and the people who depend on them across Europe. You will bring together NVISO specialists in security operations, automation, Detection Engineering, Cybersecurity Architecture and incident response to turn customer ambitions into delivered security solutions.

You will manage implementation, integration and improvement projects from kick-off through acceptance and handover to the teams responsible for ongoing operations. You will keep scope, timelines and dependencies aligned, and make sure customers and colleagues know what has been agreed, what comes next and where a decision is needed.

You will work closely with Business Development, senior management and technical experts, organising their contributions and following commitments through. Your cybersecurity knowledge will help you ask informed questions and connect technical dependencies to delivery decisions. Experts retain technical ownership; you bring the people, plans and decisions together to deliver the project.

Typical responsibilities include:

· Managing implementation projects from kick-off to acceptance, with clear scope, milestones, dependencies and responsibilities across NVISO teams and customer stakeholders;

· Securing commitments from capability leads and organising timely support and decisions from Business Development, senior management and technical experts;

· Leading customer meetings and delivery reporting, aligning expectations and communicating progress, risks and next steps in language suited to each audience;

· Managing risks, issues and scope changes, agreeing achievable plans and escalating decisions with clear options and their impact on delivery;

· Tracking effort, budget consumption and forecast-to-complete, and reporting deviations and proposed actions to the senior manager, who retains P&L ownership;

· Coordinating expert validation, customer acceptance and operational handover, then closing the project with follow-up actions assigned and lessons captured.

What we are looking for

  • You hold citizenship in one of the 32 NATO member states or the Austrian citizenship;

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent professional experience;

  • Experience managing multi-team cybersecurity or IT implementation projects, covering planning, dependencies, risks, scope changes and delivery reporting;

  • Sound understanding of security operations, detection and response, automation and cybersecurity architecture, sufficient to discuss dependencies with experts and explain their delivery implications;

  • Experience tracking effort, budgets and forecasts, and coordinating contributors and decisions across several teams without direct line-management authority;

  • Experience in consulting or customer-facing delivery is an advantage; a project management qualification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is welcome;

  • Fluent business English and professional fluency in German (at least C1-level).

Your benefits

At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components:

  • Working and learning from the best people in the European cyber security industry. We have multiple SANS Instructors working at NVISO, our staff has presented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc) and all of our technical staff can acquire deep technical security certifications (GSE, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, etc);

  • Generous training budget of 10.000 EUR + 10 man days for attending lectures rolling over 2 years;

  • Base salary range (depending on experience and skillset): 70.000 EUR p.a. – 100.000 EUR p.a.;

  • Regular team-building and fun events;

  • Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career!

  • Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad weeks within the EU);

  • Business Bike Leasing;

  • BahnCard 50 1st class + public transfer ticket or EGYM WellPass;

  • 30 holidays;

  • Company Pension Scheme;

  • Cool offices in the center of Frankfurt, Munich and Vienna (with BBQ, kicker table, table tennis, playstations, etc.).

Disclaimer for the use of AI tools throughout the application process

Please be aware that the creation and submission of application documents (e.g. CV, cover letter, case studies, etc.) using AI-powered tools is only permitted to a limited extent.

Our expectations:

  • Application documents must authentically reflect your own qualifications, personality, and motivation.

  • The use of AI for supportive purposes (e.g. spell-checking, improving wording) is acceptable.

  • Fully generated application documents created by AI without personal adaptation or review are not permitted.

  • Under no circumstances may NVISO information, data, or documents be uploaded to or processed by external AI tools.

We reserve the right to exclude applications from the selection and interview process that are clearly created primarily or exclusively by AI and show no recognizable personal input.

The purpose of this policy is to ensure a fair and transparent recruitment process and to obtain an authentic impression of our applicants.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager DACH
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Following our acquisition of the spend management platform Yokoy, Perk is building a seamless, all-in-one solution for business travel and expenses. We are seeking an experienced, German-speaking Enterprise Account Manager to act as a strategic partner to our highest-value clients across the DACH region.

In this role, you will own a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving client adoption, revenue retention, and expansion across our combined product suite. You will combine deep client empathy with data-driven consulting to establish yourself as a trusted advisor to C-level stakeholders.

What You'll Do

  • Strategic Account Ownership: Lead and nurture a portfolio of enterprise accounts, building long-term relationships with key decision-makers and executive sponsors.

  • Portfolio Expansion: Systematically identify and execute upsell and cross-sell opportunities, particularly around our expanded Yokoy spend management capabilities, to drive net revenue retention.

  • Executive Reviews: Deliver data-driven Strategic Business Reviews (SBRs) to executive stakeholders, translating travel and spend analytics into clear ROI and actionable recommendations.

  • Product & Spend Expertise: Consult on platform best practices using complete mastery of the Perk and Yokoy product ecosystems.

  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: Serve as the internal voice of the customer, collaborating with Product, Support, and Onboarding teams to guide rollouts and influence product roadmaps.

  • Proactive Issue Resolution: Address complex operational or technical challenges early, establishing scalable solutions to ensure long-term retention.

What We're Looking For

  • Languages: Native or near-native fluency in German and professional fluency in English.

  • Track Record: Proven success in Enterprise Account Management or Customer Success (SaaS, FinTech, or TravelTech preferred), with a history of consistently exceeding expansion and retention targets.

  • Executive Presence: Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to present to, negotiate with, and advise C-level executives.

  • Analytical & Strategic Mindset: Ability to translate complex spend data into high-level business strategies that align client objectives with product capabilities.

  • Feedback-Driven & Collaborative: A low-ego, team-first approach that thrives on early feedback, rapid iteration, and cross-functional alignment.

What We Offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 45mins Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - Virtual

  • Values Interview - 30mins Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.description:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use — skincare you actually look forward to.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™ and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

As Campaign Manager, you are an excellent project manager with an advertising and commercial marketing background. You bring the selling message into every campaign from day one, work closely with our Brand team, and get campaigns live across all channels and markets.

Your tasks

  • Turn each campaign on the commercial calendar into one plan: campaign page, owners and deadlines

  • Run kickoffs and drive every milestone through to go-live in all markets

  • Manage our marketing channel stakeholders (Influencer, CRM, Performance Marketing, Social Media, Website and Creative), keep everyone on the same brief and dates, and escalate early

  • Deliver postmortems with revenue against target and clear learnings per channel for the next campaign

  • Start from the commercial goal of each campaign and build concept routes aligned with the Brand team

  • Push concepts from brand storytelling toward advertising: a clear hook, a single benefit and a reason to buy now

  • Propose hero products, gifts with purchase, bundles and minimum order values by market, backed by past performance data and expected uplift

  • Bring in market trends, competitor promotions and cultural moments to sharpen every campaign

Your profile

  • 3–5 years in advertising (account or strategy side), or in growth or campaign marketing at a D2C brand. You know what makes a campaign convert

  • You can write and judge headlines, hooks and CTAs

  • You have delivered multi-channel, multi-market campaigns on time and can show the plans behind them

  • You work well with Brand and Creative teams, hold the commercial line without friction, and align people you don’t manage

  • You think in revenue, sell-through, AOV and margin, and can argue why one offer beats another

  • You take ownership, bring solutions and keep process light

  • Fluent English; a second EU language is a plus

  • Beauty or D2C experience is a plus

What We Offer

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

  • Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

  • Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Enterprise Account Executive job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for a ‘full-stack’ Enterprise Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that mostly focuses on large companies from Tech, Syntec, HCR, and B2B services, interacting with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Why is this segment interesting?

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers (creating multiple potential blockers), long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise AEs.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. In our Enterprise Sales team, you will deal with companies with more than 300 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Take a look at this testimonial from Emilie Quellec and watch Julien Plessis, both part of the Enterprise Sales team 👀


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Enterprise team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of experience in Sales, including at least 2 years managing the whole Enterprise Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


 
Location: You can apply to work at Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, Portugal, or Spain.
 
Mission
 
Join us as an iOS Engineer and help us build the most intuitive mobile banking experience for European businesses. You'll be crafting features that directly impact the daily financial operations of over 600,000 SMEs across Europe, making their business finance simpler and more efficient.
 
As an iOS Engineer at Qonto, you will:
 
• Craft cutting-edge financial features: Work on critical architectural and UI features that will directly impact our end users.
• Foster meaningful collaboration: Work closely with back-end teams, designers, and product managers to create a unified vision.

• Access to expert mentorship, Tech Weeklies & Monthlies, and conference opportunities to stay at the forefront of iOS development
 
Our methodology, the Qonto Way
We value upfront technical design, team reviews, and smart slicing, quality drives the velocity our customers need;
Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates;
Our lean toolbox, Kaizen, PDCA, lets you monitor and drive continuous improvement collaboratively with your peers and manager;
Each engineer gets access to Cursor or Copilot, and we want people who use AI to raise the bar, not just to go faster.
 
Your future team

As an iOS Engineer, you will join one of Qonto's squad teams, each organized around a clear project mission, with one team lead and full ownership of a product scope. You'll be part of a 140 mobile engineering community within a 500 Product Engineering department, working in focused teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Frontend and Backend.
 
Our stack & practices

Our app is 100% Swift, built on MVP & Clean Architecture with 35+ independent modules. We use the Coordinator pattern for scalability, and all new screens are built in SwiftUI (MVVM) with async/await — 80+ screens already migrated. Project generation and build optimization run on Tuist. CI/CD covers GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Firebase Test Lab, Sonar, and Fastlane.

We take technical excellence seriously: 30,000+ unit tests, 450+ snapshot tests, SwiftyMocky for mock generation, and LLMs integrated into our dev workflow. Our modular architecture (32 reusable modules + centralized design system) ensures fast builds, clear ownership, and safe iterations.

Want to know more about our mobile performance indicators? Read this.


About You

• Quality-driven development: Strong commitment to best practices, including unit testing (XCTests, FBSnapshots), Clean code / SOLID principles, and organized workflows
• Problem-solving approach: Pragmatic and solution-oriented approach to engineering challenges, with ability to deliver tangible value in a fast-paced environment
• Collaborative spirit: Excellent communication skills, fluent english and experience working effectively in cross-functional teams with both technical and non-technical colleagues
• Growth mindset: Curious and proactive developer who thrives on learning new technologies and contributing to a product serving hundreds of thousands of users
At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

Why Join Global Commissioning?

  • Contribute to the development of commissioning standards and best practice

Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

Motortech AI is growing across dealer groups, OEM programmes and international markets. The business does not yet have a formal presales function or established presales structure. This role provides dedicated customer-facing sales and technical support while helping the business introduce practical, consistent and repeatable ways of working.

The Solutions Consultant works closely with sales, product, implementation and senior technical colleagues to support customer discovery, product demonstrations, solution discussions and proposal development. The role combines commercial awareness with practical technical knowledge, helping customers understand how AIME can address their needs while ensuring requirements, assumptions, risks and dependencies are captured clearly.

The role will help develop early presales templates, materials and working practices through hands-on experience. Accountability for overall presales strategy, complex architecture decisions and high-risk commercial decisions remains with senior leadership and relevant specialists. The Solutions Consultant is expected to manage assigned activities with appropriate autonomy, use emerging standards and previous examples wherever possible, and escalate unfamiliar, strategic or technically complex matters promptly.


Duties & Responsibilities

•  Support qualified sales opportunities by participating in customer meetings, discovery sessions, solution discussions and follow-up activities.

•  Share recurring customer requirements, integration themes, product gaps and sales feedback with product, implementation and technical colleagues.

•  Build and maintain knowledge of AIME, relevant Keyloop products, customer environments, automotive retail processes and the technologies used in the role.


Knowledge and Experience

•  Relevant experience in a customer-facing B2B SaaS, software or technology environment, ideally involving solutions consulting, technical sales, sales engineering, implementation, customer success or technical account management.

•  Experience supporting sales opportunities through customer discovery, product demonstrations, technical discussions, workshops, proposal development or solution scoping.

Skills and Abilities

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform, powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Our modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor, working directly with our Platform Lead, who sets Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering organisation. It's a small team, so you'll cover a wide surface area, with no dedicated DevOps or QA function to hand work to.

This is a high-ownership seat. You'll take on substantial, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives, agree the direction with the Platform Lead, then drive them from first analysis through to completion with real autonomy over how you get there.

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a significant topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role. If you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in.

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Designing and building scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems.
  • Spotting and scoping problems and initiatives yourself, not just picking up assigned tickets: weighing impact, priority and timing.
  • Contributing to architectural decisions and design discussions, and bringing other teams along.
  • Driving substantial, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, coordinating with stakeholders across engineering.
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that help teams deliver faster and more reliably.
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available.
  • Sharing knowledge through code reviews, design reviews and pairing, and helping raise technical standards.
  • Spotting where AI and automation can improve how we build and run software.

 

Some of the challenges waiting for you 

You'll take ownership of one of these as your first initiative, with no other distractions.

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database.
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery.
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform.
  • Extracting and reworking common services to get us ready for our next scale level.

What you'll bring to the team 

  • 5+ years of backend development experience, with a track record of owning significant technical work from ambiguity through to completion.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms. We care more about how you think than which stack you've used.
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals and genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well).
  • Comfort with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack).
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests, as we don't have a dedicated QA function.
  • A project you can talk about in depth: the problem, what you did and the impact it had.
  • Fluent English.

Nice to have 

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS or Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong.
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other approaches (like CloudFormation).
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ or SQS are good transferable equivalents).
  • Experience owning observability and logging for highly available systems.
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers, and introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams.

 

Culture & Growth

What We Offer 

  • An International Team: Work alongside colleagues from over 20 nationalities. 
  • Growth and Development: 360° feedback reviews, an evolving career framework and an annual learning budget of €1,000+. 
  • Autonomy and Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We trust you to make decisions and contribute directly.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Revenue Operations Lead

Global expansion is broken. Without a local company, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.

Selling internationally is a maze of tax, payments, and operational friction. Most brands avoid it, or expand slowly and expensively.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce.

Pick only what you need - tax, payments, treasury, or operations - and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we become liable for a merchant's taxes. Sometimes we become the legal reseller in each market and carry the payments, tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

We go live wherever a merchant needs to sell next, for digital and physical goods. That means we own the full stack - payments, tax, compliance, treasury, and merchant experience.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

We're looking for our first Revenue Operations hire: the person who owns how revenue actually works at Outpost.

Your job is to build the RevOps machine. One source of truth for pipeline. One model that turns a merchant's volume, markets and product mix into a price. One set of numbers that the CEO, the board and the commercial team all agree on. And a handover from signed contract to live merchant that never drops anything.

This is a hands-on build role, not a reporting layer. You'll sit between sales, marketing, and operations, and you'll be the only person who can see the whole revenue system at once. You'll design it, instrument it, automate it, and then run it until it's good enough to hand over.

You'll work directly with the CEO, the Chief of Staff and the founding team.

🧗 What You'll Get

Yes, the work is intense. But in return you'll get scope and exposure most people wait 10 to 20 years to access.

You'll own a core function at a company solving one of the hardest problems in global commerce, you'll see every commercial decision before it happens, and you'll build a function from scratch with real budget and real backing. We won't handhold, but we'll coach you hard.

🧩 What You'll Do

Own the revenue system

  • Own the CRM (Attio) end to end: object model, stage definitions, required fields, hygiene, automation

  • Build the forecasting system and operationalise it with weekly pipeline review, monthly board numbers, and quarterly planning

  • Own the GTM stack: outbound sequencing, enrichment, routing, deduplication, attribution

  • Run the pipeline agentically. Build agentic system that enrich accounts, draft follow-ups, surface stalled deals and keep the CRM clean, so the team spends its time on the conversations and not the admin. You'll design the workflows, write the prompts, set the guardrails, and audit what the agents produce

Analytics & performance insights

  • Own the revenue metrics that matter: GMV, ARR, take rate, win rate, sales cycle, pipeline coverage, cost of acquisition

  • Build the reporting the company runs on, and the pack investors see

  • Build the pricing and quoting model, and the deal desk discipline around it.

Operational execution

  • Own the handover from signed contract to live merchant, with operations, tax and engineering

  • Instrument time-to-live and revenue ramp, then attack both

  • Feed commercial reality back into the roadmap. You'll know which deals we lose and why before anyone else does

Build the function

  • Write the playbooks: qualification, scoping, pricing approval, renewal, expansion

  • Set the standard for what good data looks like, and hold the line on it

  • Hire behind you once the system is running

💥 Example Projects

  • Rebuild the pipeline in Attio so every deal has a stage definition, an owner, a close date and a modelled value, and the weekly review takes 20 minutes instead of two hours

  • Build the pricing calculator that turns a merchant's volume, market mix and product mix into a price, and retire the per-deal spreadsheet

  • Cut time from signed contract to first live transaction by half, working across operations, tax and engineering

  • Build the weekly revenue pack and the monthly investor pack, and automate the data pull behind both

  • Design the commission plan for the first commercial hires

  • Score the lead universe against our ICP and rebuild outbound targeting on top of it

  • Instrument the full funnel from LinkedIn and outbound through to closed won, and prove which channel actually pays

  • Forecast GMV by market and product, and tell the founding team where the $1BN does and doesn't come from

🧱 What We're Looking For

Ideal background:

  • 4 to 7 years in revenue operations, sales operations, business operations, or GTM strategy at a high-growth fintech, payments company, or B2B SaaS

  • Has built a revenue system from zero, not inherited a mature one

  • Fluent in CRM architecture and the outbound stack. We run Attio, Instantly and Apollo, but the tool matters less than knowing how to design the model underneath it

  • Strong analytical skills — advanced Excel or Sheets, experience with BI tools

Signals we care about:

  • Ridiculous bias for action. You solve, you don't observe

  • Systems thinker who still does the work. You fix the broken report, then remove the reason it broke

  • Analytically strong. You can quantify a process, not just describe it

  • Strong EQ. You'll be telling experienced commercial people their data is wrong, and they need to thank you for it

  • Exceptionally hard working. You see work as a core part of your purpose

  • Fluent in ambiguity and chaos. Startups are not neat, this will be hard

  • Curious and resourceful. You can figure anything out

  • Clear, quantified achievements on your CV, not vague descriptions

What this role is not:

  • Not a reporting or BI role where you build dashboards and hand them over

  • Not a sales role, and not a sales-support role that takes instructions from account executives

  • Not a CRM administrator job. The tool is the smallest part of it

  • Not for someone who needs defined processes and hierarchy to be effective

🚀 Why This Role Is Different

Most revenue operations roles inherit a system and tune it. You'll write ours.

At a company that takes on legal liability for its merchants, revenue operations is not admin. Pricing accuracy is margin. Time-to-live is retention. Forecast quality is how we decide what to build and who to hire. Get it right and the whole company moves faster, permanently.

We expect whoever is in this role to grow rapidly into leading the function, and we'll back you every step of the way.

🦾 Outpost Team

Our team were leaders at Revolut, Airwallex, Adyen and Wayflyer, and we're backed by top-tier investors who have built or backed some of the world's leading fintechs.

🧾 What We Offer

  • Equity and salary in a well-funded startup

  • Ability to own your work and move fast

  • World-class training from operators who've scaled globally

  • A global mission with real impact

  • Low politics, high output

  • Chance to grow into a senior leadership role

  • A culture of builders, not talkers

🧭 Working Style

We work together in person in London 5 days a week. We believe the hardest problems are solved in the room.

🌎 Reach Out

Learn more

  1. Outpost Culture

  2. Outpost founder

Outpost is where the hard problems are. If you want to help build the engine behind global trade, we'd love to hear from you.
