jobs.title: SEO Manager (m/w/d) in Teilzeit
jobs.description:
Über GetMentioned

GetMentioned.com ist die SEO-Plattform für Sichtbarkeit in Google und KI-Suchen. Agenturen, Inhouse-SEOs und Marketing-Teams erreichen mit uns Top-Rankings für ihre wichtigsten Suchbegriffe und werden in ChatGPT, Perplexity & Co. genannt. Dafür kombinieren wir unsere eigene Content Engine TextRocket mit einem Online-PR-Marktplatz mit über 100.000 Publishern.

Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest das SEO und die KI-Sichtbarkeit von getmentioned.com. Du entscheidest, welche Themen wir besetzen, welche Seiten wir bauen oder verbessern und was als Nächstes passiert. Daneben betreuen wir noch einige wenige SEO-Kunden, denen du bei Fragen und in der strategischen Beratung zur Seite stehst; der Aufwand dafür hält sich in Grenzen.

Dein Impact

Wir verkaufen Sichtbarkeit in Google und KI-Suchen. Jede Seite, die du nach vorn bringst, bringt Besucher und Anfragen. Und wenn ChatGPT nach dem besten Anbieter für Linkaufbau gefragt wird, soll die Antwort GetMentioned lauten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du legst fest, welche Suchbegriffe und Fragen wir besetzen, in Google und in KI-Suchen.

  • Du planst die Themen, schreibst Briefings und eigene Texte und überarbeitest bestehende Seiten, mit unserer Content Engine TextRocket und KI. Wo es sinnvoll ist, steuerst du Freelancer.

  • Du kümmerst dich um Onpage und Technik: interne Verlinkung, Seitenstruktur, Meta-Daten, strukturierte Daten, Indexierung und Ladezeit, gemeinsam mit unserem Entwicklungsteam.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini und die AI Overviews GetMentioned nennen, wenn es um Backlinks, Brand Mentions und Digital PR geht.

  • Du planst Links, Erwähnungen und Digital PR für die eigene Marke über unseren Marktplatz.

  • Du beobachtest Search Console, Rankings und KI-Erwähnungen und weißt jede Woche, was sich bewegt hat und warum.

  • Du beantwortest Fragen unserer wenigen SEO-Kunden und gibst ihnen strategische Empfehlungen.

  • Du bringst deine SEO-Praxis in die Plattform ein. Du testest neue Funktionen und sagst dem Produktteam, was Kunden wirklich brauchen.

  • Du verantwortest das SEO von GetMentioned.com gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung.

Woran wir deinen Erfolg messen

  • Das eigene SEO hat einen festen Takt: Mindestens 5-10 neue oder überarbeitete Inhalte pro Woche.

  • Getmentioned.com wächst in Google: Die organischen Klicks laut Search Console steigen von Quartal zu Quartal.

  • GetMentioned wird in KI-Suchen genannt: Wir prüfen jeden Monat ein festes Set an Fragen in ChatGPT, Perplexity und den AI Overviews. GetMentioned wird bei immer mehr davon genannt.

  • Aus Besuchern werden Kunden: Die Registrierungen aus der organischen Suche steigen von Quartal zu Quartal.

  • Kunden bekommen schnell eine Antwort: Fachliche Kundenfragen sind innerhalb eines Werktags beantwortet und landen nicht mehr beim Geschäftsführer.

Was du allein entscheidest

  • Welche Themen und Seiten als Nächstes kommen und wer sie schreibt.

  • Was auf getmentioned.com veröffentlicht und überarbeitet wird, innerhalb unserer Markenregeln.

  • Freelancer beauftragst du ohne Rückfrage, innerhalb eines Monatsbudgets, das wir gemeinsam festlegen.

  • Welche SEO-Empfehlung du unseren Kunden gibst.

  • In welcher Reihenfolge du deine Arbeit angehst, solange alle Termine halten.

Unsere Werte

Nach diesen vier Werten stellen wir ein, geben Feedback und entscheiden, wer mehr Verantwortung bekommt.

  • Ergebnisse. Jede Aufgabe hat ein Ergebnis und einen Termin. Deine Zahlen kennst du, bevor jemand fragt. Wann und wo du arbeitest, entscheidest du, solange du erreichbar bist. Bewerbungen mit Track-Records sehen wir gern.

  • Schnell entscheiden. Fragen sind am selben Tag geklärt. Eine gute Entscheidung heute ist uns lieber als eine perfekte nächste Woche.

  • Direktes Feedback. Wir sagen sofort, was gut war und was nicht, in beide Richtungen. Feedback setzt du beim nächsten Versuch um.

  • Verantwortung vom ersten Tag. Wer ein Problem sieht, kümmert sich darum. Was zweimal von Hand passiert, baust du beim dritten Mal als festen Ablauf oder als Prozess mit unserem Dev Team oder KI.

Wen wir suchen

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre SEO in der Praxis, in einer Agentur oder Inhouse.

  • Du hast schon eine Website selbst nach vorn gebracht und kannst die Zahlen dazu zeigen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit der Search Console, mit Sistrix oder Ahrefs und mit einem Content-Tool wie Surfer.

  • Du schreibst gute Texte selbst mit KI und erkennst, wann ein KI-Text noch nicht gut genug ist.

  • Du priorisierst selbst. Aus zwanzig offenen Themen ziehst du das eine, das jetzt zählt.

  • Du denkst selbst. Bei einem Problem, das du noch nie gesehen hast, stellst du die richtigen Fragen, bevor du loslegst.

  • Du willst Feedback. Sagt dir jemand, was nicht funktioniert hat, machst du es beim nächsten Mal besser und diskutierst es nicht weg.

  • Du nutzt KI jeden Tag und hast Erfahrung in Claude Code / Codex und evtl. auch bereits eigene SEO Tools gebaut

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Gutes Englisch und Wort und Schrift.


Erfahrung mit KI-Sichtbarkeit, im Linkaufbau oder mit B2B- und SaaS-Websites ist ein Vorteil.
Track-Record bei eigenen Projekten und Kundenprojekten ist ebenfalls ein Vorteil.

Ehrlich kommuniziert vorab

  • Die 25 Stunden verteilst du auf alle fünf Werktage, zum Beispiel vormittags. So bist du für das Team und unsere Kunden jeden Tag erreichbar.

  • Wer lieber zuarbeitet oder SEO als Checkliste abarbeitet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich.

Was wir bieten

  • 25.000 bis 32.000 € brutto im Jahr bei 25 Stunden pro Woche, je nach Erfahrung. Das entspricht 40.000 bis 51.200 € auf Vollzeitbasis.

  • 25 Stunden pro Woche, remote.

  • Eine eigene SEO-Plattform mit Marktplatz, Content Engine und Daten, die du für unsere eigene Marke voll nutzen kannst.

  • Zugang zu Sistrix, Ahrefs und Surfer sowie KI-Tools und eigenen SEO Abläufen, mit denen wir arbeiten.

  • Direkter Draht zum Geschäftsführer mit mehr als 10 Jahren SEO Erfahrung. Enorme Entwicklungs-Möglichkeit, sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich.

  • Dein nächster Schritt: Wächst die Arbeit, kannst du mehr Stunden übernehmen und die Leitung SEO und AI Search mit eigenem Team aufbauen - auch international.

So läuft die Bewerbung

  1. Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf inkl. Website, die du nach vorn gebracht hast, mit den Zahlen dazu. Beantworte in deiner Bewerbung in genau drei Sätzen: Warum willst du genau diese Stelle? Wie genau du diese Anleitung befolgst, ist schon Teil der Auswahl.

  2. Gespräch per Video mit all unseren und Deinen Fragen.

  3. 2 Arbeitsproben & Live-Arbeit. Details folgen in der jeweiligen Runde.

About Tangible

Tangible Markets builds secondary market infrastructure for private fund LP interests. Our platforms help investors, wealth managers, fund managers and lenders buy, sell, price, finance and close secondary transactions. Our products:

Liquidity Hub: a secondary marketplace where LPs list fund interests and qualified buyers bid, with liquidity windows, tender offers and NAV lending.

Auctions: a competitive sale process for fund interests, supported by pricing models, pricing reports and market sentiment data.

Closing Platform: a transaction workflow built with a leading law firm to manage transfer documents, signatures and closing steps.

The role

You own the design of our products end to end, from research to shipped UI. You work with product, engineering and data teams on complex financial workflows used by institutional buyers, wealth advisors, lenders, fund managers and lawyers. Several products run as white-label versions for large financial partners.

Responsibilities

  • Own visual branding and design direction across every product, with a modern and consistent standard.

  • Lead the UX and UI revamp across the whole platform.

  • Design end-to-end flows across all products: onboarding, listings, bidding, pricing, financing and closing.

  • Turn complex financial and legal processes into clear, simple interfaces.

  • Design data-dense screens: pricing outputs, dashboards, reports, tables and comparisons.

  • Run user research and usability testing with buyers, sellers, advisors and partners.

  • Own the design system across products and white-label client versions.

  • Own the design process, including where AI tools fit to speed up research, prototyping and production.

  • Own design organization: files, handoff, and how work moves from design to build.

  • Set the quality bar and hold it. Nothing ships that has not cleared it.

  • Direct the product designer and review their output.

  • Work with engineering through build and QA so designs ship as intended.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of product design experience, including 3+ years on complex B2B, fintech or enterprise products.

  • Deep UX skills: information architecture, interaction design, user research and usability testing.

  • Proven experience building and maintaining a design system in Figma: components, tokens, variants and documentation.

  • Daily use of AI productivity tools in design work (for example Claude, Figma AI, v0 or Cursor) to prototype and iterate fast.

  • Experience designing multi-step, multi-role workflows with permissions, statuses and approvals.

  • Experience with multi-tenant or white-label products.

  • Working knowledge of front-end basics (HTML, CSS, component libraries) and how designs translate to code.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain design decisions to business and tech teams.

  • A portfolio showing process, trade-offs and shipped work.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of private markets, secondaries, wealth management or capital markets.

  • Experience in regulated industries: compliance flows, audit trails, disclosures and e-signature.

  • Accessibility knowledge (WCAG).

Please submit your resume, portfolio, and a brief cover letter explaining your experience and why you want to join Tangible. Portfolios are reviewed before interviews are scheduled, so make sure yours is up to date.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (Efector Development)
jobs.description:
As Destinus scales its vehicle programmes, we are looking for a dedicated Technical Project Manager to own execution across the full vehicle development stack – from propulsion and structures through avionics integration, ground support equipment, and qualification. This frees our engineers to focus on technical depth and our team leads on strategic leadership.

As one of the first hires in this group, you will manage a programme and help build the PM structure itself alongside team leads and fellow TPMs. You own execution – schedule, cross-disciplinary coordination, risk, and delivery. The engineers run the technical depth; you run the programme.

What You’ll Do

· Own end-to-end execution of vehicle-level and subsystem product development programmes – from kick-off through hardware build, test campaigns, qualification, and delivery

· Build and maintain programme plans spanning propulsion, structures, avionics, systems engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and regulatory dependencies; identify and resolve critical path risks early

· Run programme reviews and cross-functional coordination meetings; keep decisions documented and actions closed

· Work closely with engineering leads across disciplines to track technical progress and translate it into clear programme status

· Coordinate system integration activities – ensuring interfaces between subsystems (propulsion, structures, avionics, GSE) are managed, dependencies tracked, and integration milestones owned

· Manage external dependencies: supplier lead times, test facility scheduling, regulatory submissions, and customer milestones

· Proactively flag scope creep, resource conflicts, and schedule risk to leadership – with options, not just problems

· Contribute to building the PM structure, tools, and ways of working for the department alongside team leads and fellow TPMs

Requirements

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, systems, or a related engineering discipline

· 5–8 years in a hardware-heavy development environment; at least 2 in a project management, programme coordination, or technical lead role – career PMs without hardware exposure will not be considered

· Background in aerospace, defence, or a similarly regulated hardware domain; familiarity with vehicle-level or system-level development and qualification cycles is essential

· Experience managing cross-disciplinary programmes spanning multiple engineering domains (structures, propulsion, avionics, or similar) is a strong advantage

· Able to manage multiple concurrent projects across engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and testing

· Strong systems thinking – able to see the full picture, spot where the hard problems are likely to sit, and know when to dive into detail without losing the overall programme

· Strong planning skills – able to build a programme schedule from scratch, identify critical path, and keep it current

· Comfortable building structure in an ambiguous environment; pragmatic over bureaucratic

· Clear, direct communicator in English; German is an advantage

jobs.title: iOS Developer
jobs.description:
iOS Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en RTL met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een ervaren iOS Developer. Iemand die energie krijgt van het bouwen aan apps die miljoenen mensen dagelijks gebruiken. Je denkt verder dan code alleen en werkt graag samen aan betekenisvolle producten.

Jouw rol

Als iOS Developer ben je een ervaren software engineer die graag kennis deelt binnen een hecht team. Je zet de gebruikerservaring altijd centraal en bouwt mee aan stabiele, schaalbare mobiele architecturen. De techstack met Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, MVVM-C en TCA is voor jou bekend terrein.

Je werkt nauw samen met product owners, testers en Android engineers aan complete platformen. Samen vertalen jullie complexe klantvragen naar vloeiende mobiele applicaties. Je krijgt de vrijheid om jouw expertise in te zetten en processen continu te verbeteren.

Wat je gaat doen:

  • Je bouwt mee aan bekende applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, RTL Boulevard en het KNMI.

  • Je deelt jouw kennis binnen een mobile team van 35 specialisten.

  • Je vertaalt designs naar vloeiende animaties en intuïtieve interfaces.

  • Je waarborgt de codekwaliteit via code reviews en testautomatisering.

  • Je adviseert klanten over de beste technische keuzes voor hun platform.

  • Je levert een actieve bijdrage aan onze eigen kennisevents, zoals Appdevcon.


Wie ben jij?

Je hebt minstens vijf jaar ervaring met mobile development en ontwikkelt zelfstandig native iOS applicaties. Je bent blijvend leergierig en past je snel aan in een veranderende omgeving. De techstack met Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, MVVM-C en TCA is voor jou bekend terrein.

Samenwerken in een divers team is voor jou vanzelfsprekend. Je toont eigenaarschap en kijkt kritisch naar je eigen werk om de hoogste kwaliteit te garanderen. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, RTL Boulevard en het KNMI.

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6500,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen.

  • Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies.

  • De 'Gadget Kit': Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot entertainment en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dat maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een diverse groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis en zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen iOS) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

Je schakelt soepel tussen Agile/Scrum-methodieken en traditionele fixed scope/fixed price - trajecten. Als communicatief sterke professional bewaar je de rust bij tegenslag en weet je hoe je met tact en daadkracht slecht nieuws overbrengt. Je hebt ervaring met stakeholdermanagement op C-level niveau van veeleisende corporate of Enterprise klanten, waarbij je duurzame relaties opbouwt, overtuigend adviseert en effectief onderhandelt over prioriteiten en resources. jobs.title: Senior Account Manager DACH
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We are looking for a customer-oriented and results-driven candidate to join our Account Management Team. As a Senior Account Manager DACH at Perk, you will be actively contributing to our continued customer satisfaction as well as working to increase growth and margin within existing accounts.

Following our recent acquisition and rebranding, your role now encompasses our fully integrated Travel and Spend ecosystem. You will be responsible for a portfolio of large SMB accounts within the DACH market, helping them streamline not just their travel, but their entire expense management workflow. You must possess a genuine hunger to navigate your accounts in a fast-changing, hyper-growth environment, be ready to roll up your sleeves, and work hard.

What You Will Do:

  • Portfolio Management: Own a portfolio of large SMB customers and develop a high level of customer engagement with influential users (Admins, Finance Directors, Travel Managers) within those accounts.

  • Strategic Consultation: Gain a deep understanding of your customers' business and show you understand and identify with their goals as an organization. You will consult them on consolidating their financial stack by leveraging Perk’s unified Travel and Spend capabilities, identifying opportunities to optimize their expense reconciliation and cost control.

  • Product Expertise: Develop a deep understanding of the Perk portfolio of products—including our core Travel platform and our new Spend management solution. You will use this knowledge to guide customers through the benefits of an all-in-one T&E solution.

  • Expansion & Growth: Actively identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities for the Spend product within your existing book of business, driving adoption of corporate cards, automated invoice processing, and expense management features.

  • Problem Solving: Identify common problems within each account—whether related to bookings or expense workflows—and develop strategies to solve each issue in a timely manner whilst also developing foolproof methods to ensure repeat issues are a thing of the past.

  • Advocacy: Be Perk’s biggest advocate within your clients and your clients' biggest advocate within Perk. You’ll be the first one to address any issues, get support from our technical teams, and educate your clients on new product features across both Travel and Spend modules.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience within an Account Management or Customer Success role, preferably managing a portfolio of B2B clients.

  • Native or near-native proficiency in German.

  • Ability to speak and write in English fluently.

  • Experience in the Travel industry, Fintech, Expense Management, or SaaS products is highly desirable.

  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to explain complex integrations between travel bookings and financial reporting.

  • Customer-focused with a passion for working with people and solving financial pain points for businesses.

  • Excellent analytical abilities with fluency in Excel and data interpretation.

  • Solid analytical background to help clients visualise their T&E ROI.


You’ll Thrive Here If You Are:

  • A Trusted Collaborator: You care about collective team wins, foster transparent working relationships, and bring a straightforward, low-politics mindset to work.

  • Results-Driven: You know how to filter out noise and stay locked onto core objectives, taking full ownership of major milestones like key-account rollouts.

  • Feedback-Oriented: You view constructive feedback as a tool for growth, seeking input early, iterating fast, and sharing honest perspectives with your team.

  • A Strategic Client Partner: You naturally empathize with the financial and operational challenges our clients face, using those insights to build lasting, high-trust partnerships.

What We Offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

 

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 45mins Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - Virtual

  • Values Interview - 30mins Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The role 

We’re looking for a Senior Creative Designer to join our Brand team in Paris. You’ll help build a brand that is understood, remembered and trusted, making a powerful product feel simple, human and desirable. As part of our creative team, you’ll shape Brevo’s visual identity, content and digital presence across every channel and market. We believe great design starts with great thinking, so we question the brief, look for the sharpest idea and make sure it holds across every touchpoint.
 

Your impact at Brevo
  • Contribute to the evolution of Brevo's visual identity and brand guidelines, ensuring consistency across every touchpoint, from paid ads to event signage.
  • Design marketing and communication assets for product launches and campaigns, adapting concepts across channels, formats and markets (digital, social media, OOH, events, print).
  • Produce social-first content, including video, motion and short-form, for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok and X, tailored to each platform's codes.
  • Build content plans that combine organic, paid and evergreen content, then measure performance and keep improving.
  • Translate complex product features into simple, engaging messages for different audiences and markets.
  • Partner with Growth, Product, Sales and Leadership to align creative work with business objectives.
  • Experiment with new formats and AI-powered creative tools, and bring what works into the team's workflow.

    • Who you are
  • Around 6 years of experience in creative, brand or content design, ideally in an agency, startup or SaaS/tech company, with a strong portfolio of brand, content and digital work.
  • You think before you design: you take the time to understand the product, challenge briefs constructively and turn complex ideas into clear visual stories.
  • You have a solid understanding of B2B communication, paid campaigns, social media best practices and storytelling.
  • You’re comfortable with AI creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Claude…)
  • You're fluent in Figma (mandatory, including design systems) Adobe suite.
  • You're autonomous and organised, juggle several projects at once and take ownership from idea to execution.
  • You communicate in professional English (C1 or above).
  • Bonus points if you have B2C experience, speak French.
    • If you don't meet all the requirements above but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply!

    Why people love working at Brevo
  • A place to grow, together: Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood.
  • Practical perks for everyday balance: RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).

  • Flexible for life: A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.
  • Wellbeing that works: Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick and needs you, and several services related to prevention, health and personal and professional well-being on Welii platform
  • A culture that cares: From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You'll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work.

  • Creative case study (4–5 hours of work) and presentation (45 min)

Former Auditor - Senior Customer Success Manager

As a Senior Customer Success Manager (+Audit Background) at DataSnipper, you own the success of a portfolio of accounts - and you bring something additional to the role: direct experience in audit. You understand how audit teams work, what drives their priorities, and how to connect DataSnipper to the workflows that matter most inside a firm.

You are a reliable, independent operator who applies established CS frameworks and uses your audit knowledge to accelerate adoption, build credibility with audit stakeholders, and design enablement that non-audit CSMs cannot replicate. You manage onboarding, QBRs, health monitoring, and renewals with predictability and follow-through and you do it in a language audit professionals trust.

You may still be developing the full breadth of CS scope, but your audit domain credibility opens doors and unlocks conversations that are otherwise harder to access at this level.

 

About DataSnipper

Audit and finance are still massively manual and we are changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms.

Now, we are taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we do not sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence, meaning it does not just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability.

We are not just applying AI, we are redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.

 

What You Will Do

  • Act as a Credible Audit Advisor: Serve as a trusted partner to Audit Managers, Senior Auditors, and engagement team leads. You are someone who understands customer workflows, their quality standards, and their firm's operating model. Translate DataSnipper's capabilities into language and use cases that resonate with audit professionals directly.

  • Drive Adoption Aligned to Audit Workflows: Run onboarding and training sessions that are grounded in how audit teams actually work - mapping DataSnipper features to real engagement tasks, sample testing approaches, and evidence management requirements.

  • Manage Account Health with Audit Context: Use product data, stakeholder signals, and your understanding of audit operating rhythms to monitor portfolio health. Recognize when signals carry firm-wide implications such as low adoption and respond or escalate with the right context.

  • Build Audit-Grounded Success Plans: Create success plans that connect DataSnipper capabilities to audit-specific outcomes: engagement efficiency, sample coverage, review cycle speed, and quality compliance. Align milestones to audit calendar realities and firm methodology, not just generic product adoption targets.

  • Communicate ROI in Audit Terms: Articulate the business impact DataSnipper delivers using metrics and framing that carry weight with audit professionals - time saved per engagement, risk reduction, quality improvement. Run QBRs and stakeholder conversations with the credibility of someone who has worked in the field.

  • Support Expansion Using Domain Knowledge: Identify expansion signals within your portfolio and use your understanding of firm structure such as service lines, team hierarchies, engagement types to surface credible growth opportunities. Support Sales in building ROI cases that resonate with audit leadership.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally with Audit Insight: Share audit workflow intelligence with Product, Sales, and Solutions Engineering. Surface patterns that require audit expertise to interpret - methodology gaps, adoption friction specific to audit processes, feedback that non-audit CSMs are less positioned to identify.

  • Contribute Audit Knowledge to the Team: Help peers understand audit customer context. Act as an accessible internal resource for audit-specific questions to help raise the team's collective ability to serve audit accounts.

  • Maintain Systems and Portfolio Data: Keep customer data, health signals, and portfolio records accurate and up to date in internal systems. Use this data to make better decisions and support reliable reporting.

     

What You Bring

  • Audit Domain Credibility: You have worked in or directly alongside audit teams. You understand engagement lifecycles, sample testing, evidence management, team hierarchies, and the quality standards that govern audit work. This is not background knowledge - it is something you apply directly in customer conversations and account planning.

  • Experience: Ideally you have experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar client-facing role in B2B SaaS, combined with direct experience in audit - whether as an auditor, audit technology specialist, or in a client-facing role embedded in audit workflows. You understand how audit engagements are structured, what drives adoption in audit teams, and how to speak credibly to audit professionals.

  • Audit-Specific Enablement Design: You can design and execute onboarding and training programs that map to real audit workflows - including audit cycle timing, firm methodology, and engagement team structure. This requires audit fluency that cannot be substituted with general CS experience.

  • Data-Driven Approach: You use product data and health signals to stay ahead of risks and make decisions. You are comfortable in CS tools and CRM platforms.

  • Clear Communication across Contexts: You communicate clearly in both audit professional language and CS/GTM contexts. You can navigate stakeholder conversations with audit managers and firm leadership, and translate those conversations back into internal action.

  • Ownership Mindset: You take responsibility for your accounts and your own development. You ask for feedback, apply it, and look for ways to improve.

  • Collaborative Spirit: You contribute to the team including by sharing audit knowledge that makes peers more effective on audit accounts.

  • Adaptability: You handle change well. You adjust when priorities shift and keep a constructive attitude in a fast-moving environment.

  • Excellence in Communication: Professional fluency in English and Dutch (written and spoken), with the ability to engage stakeholders at all levels - from audit associates to C-suite.

jobs.title: Process Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Functieprofiel

Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software).

Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie.

Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste.


Wat ga jij doen!

In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met:

  • Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3)

  • Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform

  • Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties

  • Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst

  • Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses

  • Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren

  • Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen

  • Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein

Wat wij vragen!

  • Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering:

  • Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting

  • Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in procesautomatisering

  • Hands‑on ervaring met Siemens Step7 / TIA Portal / WinCC

  • Ervaring met ProLeiT Plant.iT

  • Bij voorkeur ervaring met OPC UA en AVEVA PI

  • De bereidheid om jezelf én de organisatie continu te blijven ontwikkelen


Wat bieden wij jou!

Werken bij NX Filtration biedt je de kans om samen met een gedreven en enthousiast team een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de professionalisering en groei van de organisatie. Je werkt in een open en informele omgeving met zeer korte communicatielijnen, waarin eigen initiatief wordt gestimuleerd.

Het betreft een zelfstandige functie binnen een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie in een internationale setting, waar je volop ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen – zowel persoonlijk als in je loopbaanambities.

Daarnaast:

  • In 2024 is een nieuwe fabriek gerealiseerd

  • Alle processen zijn volledig geautomatiseerd met ProLeiT

  • Volledige data‑integratie ten behoeve van diepgaande procesanalyses

  • Mogelijkheden voor remote support

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren software engineer of architect die inhoudelijk sterk wil blijven, maar ook graag een team verder brengt?

Bij adesso Nederland zoeken we een Lead Software Engineering. Iemand die technologie, mensen en delivery bij elkaar brengt. Je bent niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van je team, maar blijft zelf dicht bij de inhoud en onze klanten.

Je werkt met ervaren software engineers aan uitdagende klantomgevingen en helpt tegelijkertijd onze Software Engineering-practice verder uit te bouwen. Van Java en moderne frontendtechnologie tot cloud, architectuur en agentic software engineering.

Geen rol waarin je alleen maar gaat managen dus. Je blijft onderdeel van het vak.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Lead Software Engineering geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 5 tot 12 consultants en developers. Je coacht collega's, helpt ze groeien en zorgt ervoor dat zij op projecten zitten die passen bij hun kennis, ervaring en ontwikkeling.

Tegelijkertijd ben je betrokken bij onze klanten en projecten. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van delivery, denkt mee over architectuur en engineeringvraagstukken en springt bij wanneer een project inhoudelijk of organisatorisch extra aandacht nodig heeft.

Je rol bestaat grofweg uit vier onderdelen:

People & team
Je voert 1-op-1's, begeleidt ontwikkeling en performance en helpt collega's bij hun volgende stap. Je zorgt voor een goede onboarding van nieuwe collega's en bent actief betrokken bij recruitment en selectie.

Software Engineering & delivery
Je blijft inhoudelijk betrokken bij software engineering en kunt zelf een leidende rol pakken op een technisch of architectuurvraagstuk. Je bewaakt kwaliteit, planning en risico's en zorgt dat onze teams voorspelbaar en professioneel leveren.

Tegelijkertijd help je engineers zich ontwikkelen richting Agentic Engineering: minder tijd besteden aan het produceren van code en meer aan het definiëren van context, architectuur en kwaliteit, het orkestreren van agents en het reviewen en valideren van de output.

Klanten & commercie
Je ziet wat er bij klanten speelt en vertaalt dat naar kansen voor adesso. Je denkt mee in presales, voorstellen en bids en helpt oplossingen vorm te geven die technisch én commercieel kloppen. Bij bestaande klanten herken je mogelijkheden voor vervolgprojecten en uitbreiding.

Daarbij verschuift de focus steeds meer van het leveren van capaciteit naar het realiseren van engineering outcomes: sneller bouwen, moderniseren en klanten helpen hun engineeringorganisatie toekomstbestendig te maken.

Groei van onze Software Engineering-practice
Je helpt bepalen welke kennis, technologie en capabilities we als team nodig hebben. Je volgt ontwikkelingen binnen onder andere Java, frontend, cloud, architectuur en Agentic Engineering en vertaalt die naar onze manier van werken.

Je helpt daarmee niet alleen individuele engineers groeien, maar bouwt mee aan een schaalbare engineering capability binnen adesso.


We zoeken geen klassieke people manager die de techniek inmiddels heeft losgelaten. We zoeken juist iemand die software engineering begrijpt én mensen kan meenemen in de ontwikkeling van het vak.

Je hebt ruime ervaring binnen software engineering en hebt bijvoorbeeld gewerkt als Senior Software Engineer, Tech Lead, Lead Developer of Software Architect. Je hebt ervaring met Java en/of moderne software-architecturen en begrijpt wat nodig is om complexe softwareprojecten succesvol te leveren.

Daarnaast:

  • heb je circa 7–8 jaar of meer relevante ervaring binnen softwareontwikkeling en complexe projecten;

  • heb je ervaring met het begeleiden, coachen of aansturen van andere engineers;

  • kun je met zowel developers als klanten en management schakelen;

  • begrijp je onderwerpen als delivery, capaciteit, kwaliteit en projectmarge;

  • heb je ervaring binnen consultancy of projectmatige dienstverlening, of voel je je thuis in zo'n omgeving;

  • vind je het interessant om mee te bouwen aan proposities, presales en klantrelaties;

  • volg je ontwikkelingen rondom AI, AI-agents en Agentic Engineering;

  • beheers je de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed.

Certificeringen op het gebied van Java, cloud, architectuur of software engineering zijn mooi meegenomen, maar voor ons zijn je ervaring en wat je daadwerkelijk hebt gebouwd en geleid belangrijker.

Waarom deze rol interessant is

Dit is een rol voor iemand die op een punt is gekomen waarop alleen zelf software bouwen niet meer genoeg is, maar die óók niet de hele dag in managementmeetings wil zitten.

Je krijgt de ruimte om een team te ontwikkelen, invloed te hebben op onze technische richting, met klanten aan tafel te zitten én zelf inhoudelijk relevant te blijven.

adesso Nederland is met ongeveer 100 collega's compact genoeg om echt invloed te hebben, terwijl je onderdeel bent van een internationale organisatie met meer dan 13.000 collega's. Daardoor combineren we korte lijnen en ondernemerschap met de kennis, klanten en mogelijkheden van een grote Europese IT-organisatie.

En Software Engineering verandert snel. AI-agents gaan steeds meer onderdelen van de software lifecycle ondersteunen, van requirements en architectuur tot development, testing en delivery. Daardoor verschuift het werk van engineers naar het definiëren van context, architectuur en kwaliteit, en het orkestreren, beoordelen en bijsturen van AI. 

Binnen adesso willen we daar niet vanaf de zijlijn naar kijken. Als Lead Software Engineering help je mede bepalen hoe we deze ontwikkeling vertalen naar onze engineers, onze projecten en onze klanten.

Klaar om niet alleen goede software te bouwen, maar ook het team eromheen sterker te maken? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

AI is changing what "technical support" means at a fast-growing SaaS company. The old model was reactive: wait for a ticket, dig through logs, escalate up a chain until someone senior enough could unblock it. Increasingly, the first pass on an integration failure or a broken workflow can be directed rather than done line by line by hand: AI can trace through logs, draft hypotheses, and suggest fixes fast.

The job shifts with it. Instead of grinding through every stack trace yourself, you direct AI to accelerate the investigation and apply what AI can't: judgment on whether a fix is safe to ship into a live enterprise environment, whether the root cause is actually fixed or just patched, and whether this is a one-off or a pattern worth escalating to Product.

As Omnea's Technical Solutions Engineer, you're the senior technical presence sitting between Customer, Product, and Engineering. You own Omnea's most complex customer-facing technical problems end to end - gnarly integrations, cross-system issues, escalations nobody else can crack. You're the person the team calls in when something's on fire, and you're just as comfortable stepping into a customer's implementation when it gets technical.

This is a foundational hire. You'll set the technical bar for how Omnea supports enterprise customers, and help define how the function grows from here.

What You'll Do

  • Own the hardest technical problems: Lead investigation and resolution of Omnea's most complex customer issues - integrations, configuration edge cases, cross-system bugs. Direct AI to accelerate the first pass, then apply the judgment AI can't: is this safe to ship, is the root cause actually fixed.

  • Be the SWAT team between Customer, Product, and Engineering: Act as the senior escalation point when an issue is beyond what the Customer team can resolve alone, and the technical voice in the room when Product and Engineering need to understand what's really happening on the ground.

  • Get technical inside implementations: Step into live implementations when they hit technical complexity - tricky integrations, custom logic, unusual data flows - and work directly with the implementation team to get them unstuck.

  • Feed the product roadmap: Spot patterns across the issues you resolve and turn them into clear, well-scoped input for Product and Engineering, so the same problem doesn't need solving twice.

  • Build the standards as you go: Document what you learn, build the tooling and playbooks for triaging and resolving complex technical issues, and raise the bar for technical quality as the team grows around you.

What's Different About This Role

  • You'll spend more time directing AI through the first pass of an investigation than manually tracing every log line yourself. AI narrows down the likely cause fast; your job is confirming it's right and safe to act on.

  • Writing a sharp, specific brief for what you want AI to investigate or fix is now a core skill, not a nice-to-have.

  • Judgment on production risk matters more, not less: AI can suggest a fix in minutes, but you decide whether it's safe for a live enterprise environment.

  • You'll keep experimenting with AI tooling as it evolves, and bring what works back to the rest of the team.

About You

We don't expect you to have done this exact job before.

TL;DR: you're a technical, customer-facing problem-solver who's as comfortable elbow-deep in an API integration as you are explaining what went wrong to a CFO's technical lead.

  • 3-8+ years in a customer-facing technical role - technical support engineering, solutions engineering, implementation, or similar - at a fast-growing SaaS company

  • A technical background: a Computer Science or Engineering degree, prior experience as a software developer or engineer, or strong hands-on experience with SQL, APIs, and system integrations

  • Strong systems intuition: comfortable diving into unfamiliar platforms, reasoning about architecture, and figuring out where in a complex system something's actually broken

  • Comfortable directing AI tools to speed up investigation and first-draft fixes, with the judgment to know what to trust and what to double-check

  • An excellent communicator who can flex between a technical deep-dive with an engineer and a clear explanation for a non-technical stakeholder

  • Entrepreneurial and comfortable with ambiguity: you want to help build the standards and playbook for this function, not just follow one that already exists

  • High ownership: when something's broken, you own it through to resolution, and you raise your hand for the hard problems rather than waiting to be assigned them

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

jobs.description:
About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.

  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.
  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in security operations, corporate/IT security, or endpoint engineering.
  • Strong with a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Panther, Sumo Logic) — detection engineering and incident response — plus an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), access recertification, and least-privilege / PAM.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security (MDM, XDR/EDR/AV) and email / phishing defense.
  • Practical experience securing how a company uses AI internally: shadow AI discovery, DLP for AI tools, controls for AI assistants and agents, and a working risk framework for adopting new ones. You've done this for real, not from a vendor pitch deck.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills — you build tooling against APIs, not just configure consoles.
  • Track record of driving improvements end-to-end and leading initiatives with little oversight. 
  • Сlear written and spoken English for engineers and leadership.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one. 
Enhance your expertise and shape the future of FinTech. Join Vivid's talented team and help us revolutionize how businesses think about their finances!


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started. 

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

jobs.title: Head of Operations
jobs.description:
🌍 About Outpost

Global expansion is broken. Without a local entity, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.

Selling internationally is a maze of tax, payments, and operational friction. Most brands avoid it or expand slowly and expensively.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce.

Pick only what you need — tax, payments, treasury, or operations — and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we act as Merchant of Record, taking on tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

We operate across 58+ tax jurisdictions for digital and physical goods. That means we own the full stack — payments, tax, compliance, treasury, and merchant experience.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

We're looking for our Head of Operations: the person who owns how Outpost actually runs.

Today, operations at Outpost is a set of processes held together by a small group of very good people. Merchant onboarding, KYC/KYB, market launches, tax registrations, payouts, treasury approvals, chargebacks, merchant support — it all works, but it works because people push it. Your job is to turn that into a machine.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a management layer. You'll own the operational stack end to end: onboarding and activation, merchant operations, payments and treasury ops, compliance monitoring, and new market launches. You'll design the processes, build the tooling requirements with engineering, write the playbooks, and then run them yourself until they're good enough to hand over.

You'll hire and grow a small team behind you, but for the first stretch you are the team. If your instinct when something breaks is to open the dashboard and fix it rather than schedule a meeting about it, you'll do well here.

You'll work directly with the CEO and founding team, and you'll have a real say in what Outpost builds — operations is the sharpest source of product signal we have.

🧗 What You'll Get

Yes, the work is intense. But in return, you'll get scope and exposure most people wait 10–20 years to access.

You'll own a core function of a company solving one of the hardest problems in global commerce, work with senior stakeholders across PSPs, banks, tax authorities and merchants, and build a team from scratch. We won't handhold, but we'll coach you hard.

🧩 What You'll Do

Own the operational stack

  • Own merchant onboarding end to end: applications, KYC/KYB, risk review, activation, time-to-live

  • Run merchant operations day to day — support escalations, payouts, settlements, disputes

  • Own treasury operations: proceeds requests, money movement, reserves, reconciliation

  • Monitor merchant risk and compliance thresholds (chargebacks, fraud, refunds) and act before they become losses

  • Own payment operations alongside engineering: auth rates, routing, decline recovery, chargeback and fraud strategy

Build the system, not just the output

  • Turn manual processes into documented, repeatable, measurable playbooks

  • Define the operational metrics that matter and build the reporting so the company can see them

  • Work with engineering to spec and prioritise internal tooling — you are the customer for our internal ops platform

  • Kill work: automate, template, or delete anything that doesn't need a human

  • Make Outpost able to double merchant volume without doubling ops headcount

Launch and scale

  • Launch new markets with full legal, tax, payments, and operational setup

  • Onboard new PSPs, banking partners, and local acquiring in new geographies

  • Build the operational side of new products and merchant segments before they go live

  • Feed market and merchant reality back into the product roadmap

Lead

  • Hire, onboard, and grow a small operations team

  • Set standards: what good looks like, how fast we respond, what we never get wrong

  • Be the operational voice in company planning — what we can support, when, and at what cost

💥 Example Projects

  • Redesign merchant onboarding to cut time-to-live by 50% without weakening KYB

  • Build the operational launch playbook for three new markets and run the first one yourself

  • Debug delays in payouts and fix them across engineering, ops, compliance, and PSPs

  • Design reserve and settlement logic for a new merchant segment and implement it

  • Build the ops metrics dashboard: onboarding funnel, time-to-live, ticket volume, payout SLA, chargeback rate

  • Cut chargeback rate through better fraud tooling and merchant policy

  • Spec the next version of our internal ops tooling with engineering and ship it

  • Write the merchant VAT compliance playbook across EU markets with the tax team

  • Hire and onboard the first two operations analysts and get them productive in 30 days

🧱 What We're Looking For

Ideal background:

  • 6–10 years in operations at high-growth fintech, payments, or e-commerce infrastructure (Revolut, Stripe, Adyen, Wise, Mollie, Airwallex, Checkout.com, or similar)

  • Has owned a function or a large slice of one — onboarding, merchant ops, payment ops, or risk ops — not just executed within it

  • Experience building processes from zero, not inheriting them

  • Bonus: MoR platforms (Global-e, Digital River, Paddle), cross-border tax exposure, or PSP/acquirer operations

  • Comfortable with data — SQL, spreadsheets, dashboards. You measure before you decide

Signals we care about:

  • Ridiculous bias for action — you solve, not observe

  • Systems thinker who still does the work — you fix the ticket and then remove the reason it existed

  • Analytically strong — you can quantify a process, not just describe it

  • Strong EQ — you know how to read a room, a customer, or a blocker

  • Exceptionally hard working — you see work as a core part of your purpose

  • Fluent in ambiguity and chaos — startups are not neat, this will be hard

  • Curious and resourceful — you can figure anything out

  • Comfortable getting hands dirty — your default mode is to do, not delegate

  • Clear, quantified achievements on your CV (not vague descriptions)

What this role is not:

  • Not a people-management role where you run a team that does the work

  • Not a process-maintenance role — nothing here is finished

  • Not a single-function specialist who wants to stay in payments, or compliance, or support

  • Not someone who needs defined processes and hierarchy to be effective

🚀 Why This Role Is Different

This isn't about maintaining processes — it's about building the operating system of Outpost from the ground up. You won't just be in the room, you'll be writing the agenda.

Operations at an MoR is not a back-office function. It is the product. How fast merchants go live, whether money arrives on time, whether we catch risk before it costs us — that's what customers buy and where our margin lives. You'll own it.

We expect whoever is in this role to grow rapidly, and we'll back you every step of the way.

🦾 Outpost Team

Our team were leaders at Revolut, Airwallex, Adyen and Wayflyer — and we're backed by top-tier investors who have built or backed some of the world's leading fintechs.

🧾 What We Offer

  • Equity and salary in a well-funded startup

  • Ability to own your work and move fast

  • World-class training from operators who've scaled globally

  • A global mission with real impact

  • Low politics, high output

  • Chance to grow into a senior leadership role

  • A culture of builders, not talkers

🧭 Working Style

We work together in person in London 5 days a week. We believe the hardest problems are solved in the room.

🌎 Reach Out

Learn more

  1. Outpost Culture

  2. Outpost founder

Outpost is where the hard problems are. If you want to help build the engine behind global trade, we'd love to hear from you.

Qui sommes-nous ?

Notre mission

Avec Solteo, nous voulons donner toutes ses chances à l'électrification des bâtiments en soutenant ceux qui sont en première ligne : les entreprises d’installation.

⚡ Produire son électricité en solaire, se chauffer avec une pompe à chaleur, recharger son véhicule, stocker : l'électrification des bâtiments est le premier levier de décarbonation. Le photovoltaïque ouvre la marche — selon Xavier Piechaczyk de RTE : “le photovoltaïque a un grand potentiel, mais il faut accélérer rapidement”

👷‍♂️ La disponibilité des installateurs freine cette accélération. Ces professionnels limités en nombre perdent souvent du temps sur l'organisation et la gestion de projets de plus en plus techniques. Rien qu'en solaire, ils ont 4M de foyers à équiper d'ici 2030 !

💻 Solteo est la plateforme d'organisation de projets d’électrification qui aide les installateurs à gérer leur temps et leurs projets, quel que soit l'équipement posé. Nos premières métriques : 75% de temps gagné, +30% de conversion, et des utilisateurs heureux !

Le mot de la CEO

“Entreprendre est le moyen le plus efficace d’avoir un impact ! C'est pour cela que nous avons choisi le secteur de l'énergie, et plus particulièrement celui de l’électrification. Nous façonnons le monde de demain, celui de la décentralisation des énergies renouvelables : pas à pas, projet par projet. Nous accélérons cette transition et surtout, nous la rendons possible. Ce qui est sûr, c'est que nous nous sentons utiles, notre produit plaît et devient rapidement indispensable chez nos utilisateurs.
Rejoindre Solteo, c’est savoir écouter et rester attentif aux retours de nos clients et de notre marché, car ce sont eux qui façonnent la trajectoire de Solteo ! Ce produit, c’est avant tout le leur !” — Manon

Et ce poste alors ?

Le rôle

Pour accélérer notre croissance en France et à l’international, nous recherchons notre premier Sales Manager (futur VP Sales). Rattaché(e) directement à Manon (co-founder), qui porte ce rôle aujourd'hui, tu seras un(e) véritable builder, pour transformer un processus de vente encore artisanal en une machine performante, outillée et scalable, au service d'objectifs de croissance ambitieux.

Ce rôle allie une forte implication opérationnelle et une dimension stratégique : tu accompagnes l'équipe au plus près du terrain, tout en structurant notre organisation commerciale et en définissant notre stratégie de croissance.

  • Mettre en place et maîtriser la stack de prospection et les automatisations : CRM, séquences, scoring, workflows, alertes, playbooks (HubSpot, Apollo, Zapier, Make, etc.).

2. Management & Leadership

  • Manager et faire monter en compétences l’équipe Sales existante.

  • Installer des rituels qui font progresser l'équipe : points individuels, analyses de calls, coaching, challenges.

  • Entretenir l'énergie et la motivation de l'équipe, avec une culture de la performance exigeante et bienveillante.

  • Anticiper, recruter et piloter les prochaines recrutements pour faire grandir l'équipe.

3. Exemplarité & Exécution

  • Montrer l’exemple et rester au contact du terrain : tu prospectes régulièrement et tu fais avancer ton propre pipe.

  • Mener des démos convaincantes, maîtriser les objections et faire la différence face à la concurrence.

  • Faire remonter les insights terrain aux fondateurs, au Marketing et au Produit.

  • Représenter Solteo auprès des partenaires et acteurs clés du marché.

Les compétences qu’on recherche

  • Vente SaaS B2B en cycles courts : une solide expérience de la vente à volume en start-up ou scale-up, quel que soit le secteur.

  • Expérience de structuration et de management : tu as déjà encadré ou fait grandir une équipe commerciale, et tu sais expliquer quels rituels tu as mis en place et quels KPIs tu suis, et pourquoi.

  • Mindset : autonome, dynamique, proactif(ve) avec une forte fibre entrepreneuriale.

Ce qui serait un plus

Mais Solteo c’est aussi…

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Software Test Engineer to ensure the quality and reliability of software solutions used in real-world sensing and data processing systems. 

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with a Software Test Engineer who is passionate about quality, structured validation, and delivering robust software in complex engineering environments. 

As a Software Test Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and executing practical software tests to validate software components (including algorithms, cloud back-end, and user interfaces) that process sensor signals generated by fiber-optic sensing systems. You will work closely with data scientists, signal processing specialists, back-end developers, and software architects to ensure that products meet functional and non-functional requirements.

This role requires a hands-on professional with a proactive mindset, a structured approach to software testing, strong attention to detail, and the ability to understand complex technical systems and translate requirements into effective test strategies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing across edge devices, cloud services, APIs, databases, and graphical user interfaces.

  • Define test strategies, test plans, test cases, acceptance criteria, and automated test scripts for an edge and cloud software platforms.

  • Identify, document, and track software defects, ensuring clear reproduction steps and proper follow-up.

  • Collaborate with product owners, developers and engineers to understand system requirements and ensure test coverage.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of automated test frameworks and pipelines.

  • Test edge–cloud behaviour under interrupted connectivity, delayed or duplicated messages, device restarts, software updates, and synchronization failures.

  • Validate software performance, reliability, and stability under different operating conditions.

  • Support testing of software running on edge hardware, including hardware–software integration in laboratory and field environments.

  • Analyse test results and provide clear, actionable feedback to development teams.

  • Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and test results.

  • Integrate automated tests into GitLab CI/CD pipelines and help define appropriate quality gates.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, tools, and quality standards.

  • Participate in release readiness reviews and ensure software meets quality benchmarks before deployment.

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided 3 times/week.


Requirements:

Technical skills

  • Familiarity with test management and bug tracking tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail).

  • Programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, C++, Javascript or similar).

  • Experience developing automated tests using tools such as Pytest, Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or comparable frameworks.

  • Experience testing web-based graphical user interfaces.

  • Experience testing REST APIs, back-end services, or distributed software components.

  • Experience with Docker, AWS, Gitlab , Linux and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Ability to design structured, maintainable, and reproducible automated tests.

  • Familiarity with behaviour-driven development and Gherkin specifications.

Qualifications:

  • A degree in computer science, software engineering, embedded systems, or a related technical discipline or equivalent practical experience.

  • Proven experience in software testing or quality assurance.

  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and lifecycle.

  • Experience with both exploratory/manual testing and automated testing.

  • Experience testing integrated systems rather than only isolated software components.

  • Proactive in identifying risks and gaps in requirements and investigating failures across multiple system components.

  • Pragmatic and hands-on when working with hardware, software, test environments, and imperfect real-world data. 

  • Able to work independently while collaborating closely with different engineering disciplines. 

  • Able to communicate technical problems and quality risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with AWS or another cloud platform.

  • Experience testing data-driven or signal-processing systems.

  • Knowledge of embedded systems and hardware–software integration. 

  • Experience testing unreliable-network, offline, reconnection, synchronization, and recovery scenarios.

  • Experience in high-tech, industrial, or defense-related environments.

  • Experience with LabVIEW

Security & Compliance:

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.
