jobs.title: Senior Professional Services Leader
jobs.description:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
 
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?
 
 

Role Purpose

The Professional Services Domain Lead is a senior PS leader with end-to-end accountability for performance, commercial execution, and delivery quality within their domain. The Domain Lead is the authoritative voice on how Keyloop's domain products are scoped, sold, delivered, and continuously improved. They work alongside Regional Delivery Managers to drive consistent execution, and with Product, Engineering, and Sales to ensure the domain portfolio is commercially compelling, operationally fit for purpose, and delivered with repeatability at scale.

 

Operating globally and cross-functionally, this role drives the domain's PS execution, ensuring a tight interlock with all functions within the domain to execute on the domain's mission, whilst driving and adopting the core PS standards in delivery excellence. The domains are a critical operating model with the responsibility to deliver the Keyloop Fusion growth plan specific to their domain.

 

Underpinning everything is a commitment to customer outcomes — ensuring every engagement drives meaningful software adoption and delivers the business value customers contracted Keyloop to provide


Key Responsibilities

1. Domain Performance & Commercial Execution

• Own the commercial performance of the domain across all regions — revenue, margin, utilisation, and time to value.

• Drive domain pipeline in partnership with Sales and Account Management; contribute to scoping, commercial positioning, and SOW governance to ensure engagements are profitable, deliverable, and set up to achieve customer outcomes from day one.

• Lead domain performance reviews; hold a clear view of in-flight delivery risk, forecast accuracy, and margin at all times.

• Identify and pursue growth opportunities within the domain — upsell, expansion, and new use cases — recognising that customers who achieve strong outcomes on the Keyloop Fusion platform are Keyloop's most powerful commercial lever.

• Ensure PS days within Keyloop Traction programmes and Customer Success Plans are correctly scoped, tracked, and delivered to commercial commitments within the domain.

 

2. Fusion & Keyloop Platform: Commercial & Delivery Performance

• Drive the commercial performance of the domain's Keyloop product portfolio — spanning the relevant Fusion and Keyloop DMS products within scope — ensuring domain delivery contributes to PS revenue, margin, and time to value targets.

• Own the PS delivery proposition for the Keyloop products within the domain: ensure engagements are correctly scoped, commercially structured, and delivered to a consistent, repeatable standard that drives genuine customer outcomes — not just project closure.

• Work with Sales and Account Management to position domain-relevant Keyloop product implementations compellingly — translating product capability into clear commercial value and realistic delivery commitments.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure Keyloop Fusion platform products within the domain are implementation-ready: surfacing gaps in delivery readiness, configuration complexity, and integration requirements.

• Ensure consultants across all regions are equipped to deliver the relevant Keyloop product engagements within the domain confidently — with the methodology, tooling, and domain knowledge to execute at scale.

 

3. Delivery Excellence & Methodology

• Define and own delivery methodology, reference configurations, and reusable solution components for the domain — ensuring consistency, quality, and accelerated time to value across all engagements.

• Ensure domain delivery is outcome-validated, not just task-completed — every engagement should close with evidence that the customer is using the Fusion platform effectively and has achieved the outcomes they were promised.

• Partner with Regional Delivery Managers to ensure high-quality, consistent execution of domain projects globally; act as the escalation point for complex, early adopter, and at-risk engagements.

• Drive down rework and delivery variance by building repeatable, well-documented delivery patterns that consultants can execute without reinventing the wheel.

• Lead domain input into Keyloop Traction tier design — ensuring Launch, Accelerate, and Supercharge tier definitions reflect realistic, high-quality domain delivery with clear customer outcome criteria at each tier.

 

4. Customer Outcomes, Adoption & Success

• Champion Keyloop's mission to set customers up for success — ensuring every domain engagement is designed, delivered, and measured with that outcome at its centre.

• Define what good looks like for customer software adoption within the domain: the benchmarks, adoption milestones, and outcome indicators that signal a customer is genuinely succeeding on the Fusion platform.

• Ensure adoption and outcome validation is built into domain delivery methodology — not left to Customer Success to pick up post go-live.

• Work closely with Customer Success to track domain customers through the adoption curve; identify patterns where customers are underperforming against expected outcomes and feed those insights back into delivery approach.

• Ensure smooth, knowledge-rich handovers from PS delivery into Customer Success and Support.

• Use customer outcome data to continuously improve domain delivery.

 

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Product: Provide structured, evidence-based feedback from PS and customer engagements to influence the domain roadmap.

• Engineering: Work with R&D and Fusion platform engineering to ensure solution feasibility, delivery scalability, and that products are ready for implementation at pace.

• Sales: Support commercial conversations, scoping reviews, and customer-facing positioning for domain-specific engagements.

• Customer Success & Support: Ensure smooth handover from PS delivery into CS and Support; share domain knowledge that helps CS and Support teams accelerate adoption.

• PS Ops: Collaborate on forecasting, capacity planning, and tooling to ensure domain activity is accurately reflected in operational reporting.

 

6. Capability Building & Knowledge

• Own the domain knowledge base within PS — ensure consultants across all regions have the skills, materials, and structured training needed to deliver domain engagements confidently.

• Identify capability gaps within the global PS delivery community for the domain; design and implement targeted development to close them.

• Build and maintain a domain centre of excellence: best practices, lessons learned, delivery patterns, and configuration guides.

• Drive the onboarding and accreditation of co-delivery partners and GDC teams on domain delivery standards.

 

7. Automation, Digitisation & Continuous Improvement

• Lead the identification and implementation of automation opportunities within domain delivery.

• Monitor delivery performance data to surface patterns, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities; translate insight into action.

• Champion a continuous improvement culture within the domain: structured retrospectives, feedback loops from customers and consultants, and rapid iteration on what isn't working.

• Contribute to Keyloop PS thought leadership — bringing domain expertise to market positioning, customer education, and internal capability.


Skills, Knowledge & Experience

Essential

• Senior leadership experience in Professional Services within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.

• Demonstrable commercial acumen: experienced in revenue management, margin accountability, scoping, and contributing to the sales cycle.

• Deep domain expertise within the relevant Keyloop product area — able to operate as the authoritative voice on implementation approach, configuration, and customer outcomes.

• Proven ability to drive delivery consistency across geographically distributed teams.

• Strong cross-functional influencing skills: able to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Sales, and CS without direct authority.

• Experience operating in or contributing to hub or centre-based delivery models.

• Data-driven: uses performance insight to manage, improve, and hold teams to account.

 

Desirable

• Knowledge of the automotive dealer or vehicle retail industry.

• Experience with productised PS frameworks and tiered onboarding models.

• Familiarity with delivery automation tooling and digitised project delivery workflows.

• Experience with the Keyloop Fusion platform, Fusion products, or Keyloop DMS solutions.


Qualifications
Education - Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or equivalent. Relevant postgraduate qualification desirable. 
 
Certifications - PRINCE2, PMP/PMI or equivalent desirable. SaaS or domain-specific accreditation an advantage. 
 
Experience - 10+ years in PS, consulting, or technical leadership roles within a SaaS or enterprise software environment. 
 

What 'Great' Looks Like in This Role

• Owns the domain like a P&L — clear on the numbers, the risks, and what needs to happen next.

• The go-to person for Regional Delivery Managers when a domain engagement is complex, at risk, or commercially sensitive.

• Trusted by Product and Engineering to represent what customers actually need — not just what consultants find hard.

• Builds a domain delivery community that raises its own bar — through shared knowledge, honest retrospectives, and high standards.

• Treats customer outcomes as the real definition of delivery success — every engagement is measured by whether the customer is genuinely succeeding on the Fusion platform, not just whether the project closed.

• Brings commercial and delivery insight to every cross-functional conversation.

Why join us?
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
 
An inclusive environment to thrive
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity.  We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.
 
Be rewarded for your efforts
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
 
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
 
We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce.  We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.
 
"At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity."

Vacature: Senior Business Analist Pensioenen

Bij IG&H zoeken we ervaren Business Analisten met diepgaande kennis van pensioenen. Vanuit jouw expertise ben je in staat om samen met onze klanten te bepalen hoe zij optimaal gebruik maken van onze standaardoplossingen. Je denkt inhoudelijk mee, stuurt aan op verbetering en helpt de sector vooruit.

Jouw rol als Business Analist Pensioenen

Als Business Analist binnen het pensioendomein lever je directe impact. Je brengt je analytische vaardigheden en domeinkennis in bij digitale transformaties, de implementatie van nieuwe IT-systemen en de voorbereiding op de Wet toekomst pensioenen.
Je werkt technologieonafhankelijk en fungeert als schakel tussen business en IT. Samen met collega’s uit disciplines als low-code development, system configuration en organisatieverandering draag je bij aan duurzame oplossingen.

Je helpt klanten hun behoeften scherp te krijgen, specificeert heldere requirements en bouwt mee aan onze modelgedreven werkwijze en pensioenontologie. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega’s en draag je bij aan de verdere professionalisering van ons team.

Hoe onderscheidt IG&H zich als consultancy binnen pensioenen?

IG&H combineert diepgaande sectorkennis met technologie en uitvoering. jobs.title: Team Lead, Data Engineering
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Data Engineering Team Lead to lead the Data Platform team at DataSnipper.

Every decision DataSnipper makes about its products runs through the data platform: which features land, which customers are getting value, what we bill for, what we fix next, and which AI capabilities add the most value. You will lead a team of two data engineers who own the systems that make that possible. That means how usage events get captured across a growing set of products, how they become trustworthy models in Snowflake, and how Customer Success, Product and GTM get to answers without waiting on us.

This is a player-coach role in a small, high-ownership team. You are responsible for the people, the roadmap and the technical direction, and you stay hands-on enough to ship alongside the team and make architectural calls credibly. At DataSnipper, Team Lead is our entry point into engineering management: the same people, delivery and product responsibilities as an Engineering Manager, on a smaller team.

We are a handful of people serving the whole company, so your judgment about what not to build matters as much as what the team ships.

About DataSnipper

DataSnipper is the driving force behind an intelligent automation platform that’s transforming the world of audit and finance.

Founded in 2017, DataSnipper has skyrocketed and is now OFFICIALLY the fastest-growing software company in the Netherlands according to Deloitte Fast50 and recently achieved Unicorn status in our latest funding round. With over 400.000 users in 125+ countries and a second base in the heart of New York City, DataSnipper is shaking things up. And we’re not stopping there. At DataSnipper, we’re always on the lookout for innovators who think outside of the box. New ideas aren’t just welcomed at DataSnipper–they’re essential.

What your team owns

The Data Platform team works across three areas:

  • Data Platform: reliable, scalable infrastructure that gets the right data to the right place

  • Internal Analytics: a self-service platform so every team can be data-informed without a ticket

  • Customer-facing Analytics: the dashboards and exports customers use to see the value they get from DataSnipper

Concretely, you would be walking into billions of usage events flowing from our Excel Add-in, web apps and product backends through Azure Event Hubs into Snowflake; a dbt estate built on medallion principles and managed in dbt Cloud; Terraform-managed Snowflake and Azure infrastructure; and a set of product teams shipping AI agents faster than we can instrument them.

You will also find real, named open problems rather than a tidy platform: event capture mid-consolidation, multiple methods of user attribution, and a data quality layer that is designed but not yet built. We would rather tell you that up front.

What you will do

Lead the team

  • Lead a team of two data engineers through outcomes, not tasks: set clear goals with the team and trust them to figure out how

  • Make the team measurably better: raise the engineering bar, grow each engineer into bigger problems, and address performance issues directly when they arise

  • Run regular 1:1s, give clear and timely feedback, and own each engineer's goals and development

  • Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, documentation and operational excellence

  • Take part in hiring and help shape the team's scope as it evolves

Own direction and delivery

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success and GTM to shape the team's roadmap, turning vague data requests into scoped, well-defined work

  • Make the trade-offs a small team serving the whole company needs: what to build, what to defer, and when a request shouldn't become a pipeline

  • Set the technical direction and make the architectural calls that shape the team's systems

  • Keep Snowflake performance and cost, tech debt, dependencies and compliance obligations (audit logging, vulnerability remediation, Vanta evidence) visible and under control

  • Be the person other engineering teams come to when they need to instrument something new

Stay hands-on in the data platform

  • Contribute to the event ingestion architecture end to end: Azure Event Hubs, Snowpipe, Fivetran, and our shared Python/TypeScript event client libraries

  • Build and review dbt transformation pipelines that stay reliable as volume, source count and model complexity grow

  • Define and enforce event contracts and schemas so product teams can instrument new features without silent breakage downstream

  • Evolve the core data models (event, user, license, company) and integrate new sources such as product backends, MongoDB, HubSpot and billing

  • Guide reverse ETL and activation work that pushes modeled data back into HubSpot, MongoDB, Postgres and GTM reporting

What you bring

Leadership

  • At least 1 year leading engineers as a team lead or engineering manager: 1:1s, feedback, goal setting, performance, and development

  • An empowerment style of leadership: you lead through outcomes and trust, not by assigning tasks

  • Early evidence of growing engineers and raising a team's bar, and the willingness to address performance issues directly

  • Strong product aptitude: you can challenge the framing of a request, translate stakeholder needs into technical solutions, and make roadmap trade-offs


Data engineering

  • 7+ years in data engineering or a closely related backend/platform role, with a track record of owning a data platform area end to end

  • Deep SQL and strong Python, including query optimization and performance tuning on a cloud warehouse

  • Production experience with a cloud data warehouse (we use Snowflake) and a modern transformation framework (we use dbt)

  • Experience with event-driven / streaming ingestion and its failure modes: schema drift, duplication, late data, backfills

  • Experience on a cloud platform at the infrastructure level (we're on Azure; AWS/GCP transfers fine)

  • Solid data modeling fundamentals and the ability to defend a modeling decision to both engineers and business stakeholders

  • Experience operating data systems in production with a focus on reliability, observability and maintainability


How you work

  • Excellent communication in English and genuine comfort working directly with non-technical stakeholders

  • Bias to action, a strong sense of ownership, and the judgment to prioritize when demand exceeds capacity

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up, ideally as an early member of a data team

  • Experience hiring engineers or helping a team expand its scope

  • Experience with product analytics tooling (Mixpanel, RudderStack) and warehouse-native BI (Netspring/Optimizely Analytics, Omni, Embeddable, or similar)

  • Experience building data products for AI or agent consumption: semantic layers, metrics layers, MCP servers, or governed self-service access

  • Experience with Terraform, Docker and data governance at scale

  • Reverse ETL experience and familiarity with CRM data models (HubSpot, Salesforce) or customer success platforms


What we offer

  • Being part of one of the fastest-growing scale-ups in the Netherlands

  • Make an impact by disrupting the audit industry with us

  • A step into engineering management, with Engineering Manager scope on a small team

  • 28 vacation days

  • Excellent salary

  • Pension plan

  • Stock participation plan

  • Hybrid work (Amsterdam-based)

  • International team and environment

  • Daily lunch

  • Mental health support (OpenUp)

  • Social events and team activities

Recruitment steps

  1. Recruiter screen

  2. Hiring Manager interview

  3. System design interview

  4. Product interview

  5. Final interviews with Engineering leadership

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience.

Our hiring decisions are merit based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role.

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. The Role
We’re scaling rapidly, and as we expand our reach, launch new products, and enter new markets, we need to stay sharp, scalable, and human. That’s where you come in.

We are introducing a newly created People Advisor role on a Fixed-Term Contract. This isn't just about managing a queue of cases; it's a unique project to build a legacy.

We want you to harness modern systems and AI to revolutionize how we manage employee relations, uncover casework insights, and proactively empower our business leaders.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, has the curiosity to pioneer AI-driven ways of working, and brings deep experience handling complex, international ER cases.

You'll collaborate closely with our People team across the UK, Barcelona, and Boston. If you want to lead a high-impact project that will meaningfully elevate our people and performance, we’d love to meet you!


What you’ll do

  • Develop and implement next-generation ways of working, utilizing AI integration to streamline case management, data analysis, and manager enablement.

  • Act as a trusted co-pilot to our leaders, empowering them to confidently navigate performance, conduct, probation cases, attendance concerns, and policy changes.

  • Maintain flawless, compliant documentation while providing high-quality, human-centric support that ensures our policies are applied consistently across the region.

  • Transform raw data into strategic insights, highlighting trends and early warning signs so we can intervene proactively rather than reactively.

  • Drive ER cases from open to resolution with exceptional efficiency, minimizing timelines without compromising on care or compliance.

  • Partner seamlessly with the wider People Team and business units to ensure smooth, aligned delivery of all ER matters.

 

What you’ll bring

  • A forward-thinking mindset and tech proficiency: Practical experience using AI tools to drive efficiency, enabling you to successfully embed modern workflows into our daily casework.

  • Exceptional judgement and coaching skills: The ability to balance structured case processes with human nuance, providing co-pilot support that leaves managers feeling confident and empowered.

  • Deep ER expertise and pace: Strong, hands-on experience navigating complex ER, performance, and conduct cases across the UK and Europe, ensuring matters progress swiftly with noticeable reductions in delays.

  • Strategic partnership and data utilization: The ability to build deeply integrated, trusted partnerships across the business, using clear, reliable case data to support planning and mitigate risks.

  • Relentless attention to detail: A highly organized approach guaranteeing an impeccable standard of documentation accuracy and regional compliance.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

jobs.title: Data Enablement Officer
jobs.description:
At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.

Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,000 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!

Data Enablement Officer

Help shape how Efficio uses data responsibly, securely and effectively.

We are looking for a Data Enablement Officer to establish and lead Efficio’s data governance framework, helping us protect client data while enabling its responsible use across our services, analytics, products and AI capabilities.

This is a highly visible role at the intersection of data, technology, AI, risk and client delivery. You will work across the business to turn complex contractual, regulatory, privacy and security requirements into practical guidance that enables teams to innovate with confidence.

Initially, the role will have a strong advisory and enablement focus: helping teams understand client requirements, assess new uses of data and make proportionate, risk-based decisions. As our governance model matures, the role is expected to take greater ownership of the framework and delegated authority for lower-risk decisions.

What you'll be doing

Establish our data governance framework

You will assess our current data-handling practices and develop a practical, scalable governance framework covering the lifecycle of client data – from collection and classification through to access, use, sharing, storage, retention and secure deletion.

You will develop and maintain policies and standards covering areas including:

  • Client data handling and classification

  • Data reuse and fair usage

  • Use of client data within Efficio products

  • Use of data with AI tools, including third-party and self-hosted solutions

  • Data access and security

  • Retention, archiving and secure disposal

  • Anonymisation and aggregation

  • Third-party data sharing

  • Policy exceptions and escalation

You will also help establish and maintain our information asset inventories, data flows and AI asset registers.

Enable responsible use of data and AI

A key part of the role will be helping teams determine what we can do with data, under what conditions, and with what safeguards.

You will establish a consistent approach for assessing new and changing data use cases, considering factors such as:

  • Why the data was originally obtained

  • Client and contractual restrictions

  • Data sensitivity and classification

  • The proposed use and intended recipients

  • Security and access controls

  • Retention requirements

  • Legal, client and reputational considerations

For AI use cases, you will help define which activities are permitted, restricted, require additional review or are prohibited. This will include the use of prompts, uploaded files and connected data sources, as well as expectations around human oversight, output validation and accountability.

Govern products, platforms and technology

You will define the conditions under which client data can be stored or processed using Efficio products, SaaS platforms, cloud services and AI tools.

Working closely with Technology, Information Security, Legal and Privacy teams, you will assess areas including:

  • Data residency and international transfers

  • Encryption, access controls and logging

  • Supplier and subcontractor access

  • Data retention, backups and deletion

  • Exit and data-export arrangements

  • Use of customer data for AI model training, product improvement or other secondary purposes

You will help ensure that unapproved platforms are not used for client data without appropriate assessment and documented approval.

Support new solutions and innovation

You will work alongside teams designing and deploying new data, software, analytics and AI solutions, providing governance input from an early stage.

Ahead of launch, you will help confirm that the appropriate governance, legal, privacy and security reviews have taken place and that material risks have been appropriately addressed.

Where issues remain, you will recommend practical remediation, escalation or, where necessary, a delay to rollout. Acceptance of significant residual risk will remain with the appropriate executive or governance committee.

Build governance that works in practice

This role isn't simply about writing policies. We want to create a governance model that teams can understand and use.

You will help develop:

  • A clear data governance operating model and decision-rights framework

  • Practical data, AI, security, reuse and retention policies

  • Data and AI use-case assessment processes

  • Risk-classification and escalation models

  • Policy exception processes and decision registers

  • Product and AI platform assessment standards

  • Solution launch-readiness checklists

  • Training, guidance and supporting materials

  • Governance reporting for senior leadership and relevant committees

You will coordinate, advise and constructively challenge stakeholders across the organisation while recognising that responsibility for managing data risk is shared across business owners, data owners, Legal and Privacy, Information Security, Technology and senior governance forums.

Client engagement

This will also be an important client-facing role.

You will participate in client discussions where required, confidently explaining Efficio's approach to data governance, security and responsible data use.

You should be comfortable responding to questions about how client data is accessed, used, stored, shared, retained and protected, translating technical or governance concepts into clear, credible explanations for different audiences.

What we're looking for

We are looking for someone with experience across one or more of the following areas:

  • Data governance or data management

  • Data privacy

  • Information security

  • Technology or operational risk

  • AI governance or responsible AI

You will also bring a practical understanding of modern technology environments, including SaaS, cloud, analytics and AI platforms.

You'll be someone who can operate comfortably between policy and practice – able to understand complex requirements while recognising the commercial and operational realities of a consulting and technology-enabled business.

In particular, you will be able to:

  • Translate complex regulatory, contractual and security requirements into practical business guidance

  • Apply proportionate, risk-based judgement rather than relying on a purely rules-based approach

  • Influence and challenge senior stakeholders constructively

  • Work effectively across Technology, Security, Legal, Privacy and business teams

  • Balance commercial objectives and innovation with appropriate governance

  • Communicate confidently with clients and senior internal stakeholders

  • Build processes and frameworks that are robust without creating unnecessary bureaucracy

  • Navigate emerging areas where the answer may not always be immediately clear

What success looks like

Success in this role will mean that teams understand how to use data appropriately rather than simply being told what they cannot do.

We will look at measures including adoption of priority policies, review turnaround times, reduction in unapproved tool usage, effective management of exceptions, quality of governance reporting, stakeholder feedback and a reduction in recurring governance issues.

Ultimately, the role will be judged on its ability to achieve both sides of our data ambition: protecting our clients and Efficio while enabling appropriate, secure and innovative use of data and AI.

jobs.title: Dessinateur Projeteur CAO
jobs.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Au sein de l'équipe technique, vous concevez en CAO les pièces et sous-ensembles mécaniques de nos produits, dans nos drones et leurs équipements embarqués. Votre quotidien est la modélisation sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks : mécanismes et pièces imprimés en 3D, intégration des composants électroniques, assemblages complets.

Vous faites évoluer rapidement les designs à partir des impressions et des essais, et vous produisez les plans, nomenclatures et documents de montage des versions validées.

Missions principales

Conception CAO (cœur de métier : 70 %)

  • Concevoir et modéliser sous Fusion 360 et Solidworks des pièces et sous-ensembles : structures, carters, supports, fixations, interfaces

  • Concevoir des mécanismes imprimés en 3D : charnières, verrouillages, clips, pièces mobiles

  • Intégrer les composants électroniques dans la CAO : implantation des cartes, moteurs, ESC, batteries et capteurs, passage des câbles, refroidissement, accessibilité pour la maintenance

  • Appliquer les règles de conception FDM et autres procédés : orientation, épaisseurs, jeux et tolérances d'assemblage, inserts, limitation des supports

  • Structurer les assemblages (paramétrage, composants réutilisables) pour faciliter les évolutions

  • Assurer la gestion des versions des fichiers CAO

  • Réaliser des conceptions paramétriques et modifiables

Prototypage rapide (15 %)

  • Enchaîner des cycles courts conception → impression 3D → test → correction

  • Préparer les impressions sous OrcaSlicer et assembler les prototypes

  • Faire évoluer les designs à partir des retours d'impression et d'essais

Plans et documentation de production (10 %)

  • Réaliser les mises en plan et les nomenclatures des pièces et sous-ensembles validés

  • Participer à la rédaction des gammes de montage et des instructions d'assemblage

  • Participer aux modifications des schémas de câblage

Essais (5 %)

  • Participer aux essais de validation : banc, sol et, le cas échéant, essais en vol encadrés

  • Présenter régulièrement l'avancement à l'équipe technique

Profil recherché

Formation et expérience

  • Bac+2/+3 (BTS CPRP ou CPI, BUT GMP, licence pro) en conception mécanique, génie mécanique ou mécatronique

Compétences techniques

  • Bonne maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO 3D, idéalement Autodesk Fusion et SolidWorks (CATIA ou d'autres)

  • Conception de mécanismes et d'assemblages

  • Règles de conception pour l'impression 3D FDM ; pratique d'OrcaSlicer ou d'un autre slicer

  • Mise en plan, cotation et tolérancement

  • Bases en électronique embarquée : lecture de schémas, câblage, soudure

Atouts

  • Connaissance du monde des drones (multirotors, voilure fixe, ArduPilot / PX4)

  • Notions d'aérodynamique (portance, traînée, profils, hélices)

  • Projets personnels ou associatifs en drone, robotique ou impression 3D (portfolio CAO apprécié)

  • Intérêt pour l'aéronautique, le spatial ou la défense

Qualités personnelles

  • Goût pour le prototypage et le travail « hands-on » et la CAO "bien faite"

  • Rigueur et sens du détail, indispensables dans un contexte défense où la fiabilité des pièces est critique

  • Autonomie, force de proposition et esprit d'équipe

jobs.description:
Wil jij de samenwerking tussen intelligente systemen en de gebruiker verkennen, verbeteren én vanuit die kennis innovatieve toepassingen ontwikkelen? Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Als R&D Engineer Human Machine Teaming (HMT) ben je betrokken in de hele keten van onderzoek naar hoe intelligente en autonome systemen de mens kunnen ondersteunen in complexe taakomgevingen.

Als ervaren kracht verwachten wij dat je je comfortabel voelt in verschillende rollen en je moeiteloos beweegt tussen projectleiding, proposal management en onderzoek. Dit betekent dat je niet alleen het initiatief neemt tot nieuwe projecten maar ook de klantvraag uitwerkt en je inhoudelijk meewerkt aan projecten waarin je de voortgang bewaakt en proactief communiceert richting de opdrachtgever!

Je ontwerpt de interactie tussen gebruiker en geavanceerde systemen, ontwikkelt proof-of-concepts en demonstrators en/of beproeft wat wel en niet werkt in experimenten in onze simulatie- en XR-omgevingen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als R&D Engineer Human Machine Teamings  bij NLR verken je voor uiteenlopende projecten innovatieve mens – techniek samenwerkingsconcepten. Soms zijn dit interne kennisontwikkelingsprojecten of Europese onderzoekscalls, ook werk je voor civiele klanten en defensie.

Je werkt daarbij samen met collega’s met uiteenlopende expertises, zoals Human Factors specialisten, UX-designers, Software ontwikkelaars, AI-experts en Onderwijsdeskundigen. Hierbij maak je gebruik van onze AR/VR, spatial computing en human-in-the-loop simulatieomgevingen. 

Een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Je bent bekend met de (on)mogelijkheden van de nieuwste AI-technologie, vergaard nieuwe kennis hierover, en bedenkt hoe dit ingezet kan worden om mensen te ondersteunen in hun dagelijks werk. Je bekijkt vanuit een technologisch oogpunt de interactie tussen mens en intelligente systemen. Hoe kan je een AI of automatisering zo ontwerpen dat het goed samenwerkt met de menselijke operator?

  • Jij bedenkt en ontwerpt met je collega’s nieuwe samenwerkingsconcepten voor verschillende levels van autonomie en werkt deze uit in een testomgeving. Je begeleidt het (co-)ontwerpproces en softwareontwikkeling en evalueert het uiteindelijke resultaat in een operationele omgeving of gecontroleerd experiment. Uiteindelijk publiceer je de resultaten wanneer mogelijk in een wetenschappelijk tijdschrift.

  • Je bedenkt en leidt onderzoeksprojecten in opdracht van (externe) stakeholders of voor interne kennisontwikkelingsprojecten.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent iemand die in kansen denkt en nieuwsgierig is om bij te dragen aan oplossingen. Met je creatieve instelling maak je nieuwe technieken snel eigen en weet je deze te vertalen naar concrete resultaten!

Daarnaast:

  • Beschik je over aantoonbaar WO werk- en denkniveau. Je hebt bijvoorbeeld een afgeronde opleiding of PhD in Human-Computer Interaction,  Design for Interaction,  Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science of een vergelijkbare studie waarin AI en/of Mens Machine Interactie een belangrijke rol speelt;

  • Heb je minstens 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minstens 3 jaar kennis en ervaring op het gebied van AI of HIS en/of in relevante onderzoeksprojecten;

  • Heb je ervaring met het leiden van ontwerp- of onderzoeksprojecten gericht op  geavanceerde, autonome en/of intelligente systemen in complexe taakomgevingen;

  • Heb je kennis van en ervaring met het toepassen van AI-technieken en software ontwikkeling, zoals praktische ervaring met Python, NLP / LLM,  en ML-frameworks. Of hebt ervaring met ontwikkeling en implementatie van UI/UX design voor informatie intensieve systemen en/of complexe werkomgevingen;

  • Ben je bereid om je te verdiepen in (militaire) luchtvaartoperaties;

  • Kun jij je in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal zowel mondeling als schriftelijk uitstekend uitdrukken.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten.

Naast dit alles bieden wij jou:

  • De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken;

  • 45 verlofdagen (bij fulltime dienstverband);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer.

  • Een zorgtoelage via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Bij de afdeling Training & Simulatie werken op dit moment rond de 90 deskundigen op het gebied van selectie, training, simulatie, informatica, luchtvaart en psychologie. De afdeling is groeiende, multi-disciplinair en jong qua leeftijdsopbouw en beschikt over onderzoeksmiddelen zoals verschillende vliegsimulatoren, een battlelab en een laboratorium dat zich richt op AR/VR-innovaties.

Binnen deze afdeling werk het HMI-T team nauw samen met collega’s binnen de rest van Training & Simulatie én met collega’s van andere afdelingen binnen NLR. Ook wordt bij de stakeholders op locatie gewerkt. Een plezierige werkomgeving vinden we essentieel. De sfeer binnen de afdeling is informeel en collegiaal en we vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zich thuis kan voelen bij ons.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties.

Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt.

jobs.title: Data Platform Architect (Snowflake)
jobs.description:
Bouw de data-architectuur waarop organisaties hun volgende stappen in data en AI kunnen zetten.

Wil jij organisaties helpen bij het bouwen van toekomstbestendige dataplatformen met Snowflake, Azure Databricks of Microsoft Fabric én werken in een ambitieus Data & AI-team?

Bij adesso zoeken we een Data Platform Architect die verder kijkt dan alleen technologie. Iemand die begrijpt hoe architectuur, data, cloud en AI samenkomen en die klanten helpt om daarin de juiste keuzes te maken.

Jouw rol

Als Data Platform Architect ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen van schaalbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige data-architecturen.

Je adviseert klanten over de architectuur, implementatie en het gebruik van intelligente dataoplossingen binnen de Snowflake AI Data Cloud, Azure Databricks of Microsoft Fabric.

Daarbij kijk je verder dan het platform zelf. Je vertaalt business- en datavraagstukken naar een technische architectuur en bepaalt samen met de klant welke technologie, tooling en manier van werken daarbij past.

Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen strategie en uitvoering. Je kunt een architectuur neerzetten, maar begrijpt ook wat ervoor nodig is om deze daadwerkelijk te implementeren.

Wat ga je doen?

·       Ontwerpen van schaalbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige data-architecturen;

·       Adviseren van klanten over de inzet van Snowflake, Azure Databricks en Microsoft Fabric;

·       Vertalen van business-, data- en AI-vraagstukken naar concrete technische architecturen;

·       Ontwerpen van moderne Data Warehouse-, Lakehouse- en Data Platform-architecturen;

·       Adviseren over datamodellering en architectuurprincipes, waaronder Kimball en Data Vault;

·       Bepalen van architectuurprincipes rondom security, governance, performance, schaalbaarheid en kosten;

·       Adviseren over de technologische roadmap van het dataplatform;

·       Ondersteunen bij de selectie en integratie van tools, zoals dbt, Dagster, Rflow en Azure Data Factory, en deze implementeren op het dataplatform;

·       Meedenken over CI/CD, DataOps en Infrastructure as Code;

·       Begeleiden van Data Engineers en andere technische specialisten bij de implementatie van de gekozen architectuur;

·       Sparren met stakeholders op zowel technisch als strategisch niveau;

Samenwerken met Data Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Engineers en andere specialisten binnen ons Data & AI-te


We zoeken geen architect die alleen mooie plaatjes maakt. Je begrijpt hoe moderne dataplatformen daadwerkelijk worden gebouwd en kunt technische keuzes onderbouwen.

·       Je hebt:

·       Ruime ervaring binnen Data Engineering, Data Architecture of een vergelijkbare technische rol;

·       Ervaring met het ontwerpen van moderne cloud-native dataplatformen;

·       Diepgaande kennis van minimaal één van de volgende platformen: Snowflake, Azure Databricks of Microsoft Fabric;

·       Ervaring met moderne Data Warehouse- en Lakehouse-architecturen;

·       Kennis van datamodellering, bijvoorbeeld Kimball en Data Vault;

·       Ervaring met data-integratie, ETL/ELT en orchestration;

·       Kennis van security, governance, performance en schaalbaarheid binnen moderne dataplatformen;

·       Ervaring met CI/CD, DevOps en bij voorkeur Infrastructure as Code;

·       Het vermogen om complexe technische vraagstukken te vertalen naar heldere keuzes en oplossingen;

·       Ervaring met het adviseren van klanten en stakeholders;

·       Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

Mooi meegenomen

Heb je daarnaast ervaring met een aantal van onderstaande technologieën of onderwerpen? Dan is dat mooi meegenomen:

·       dbt;

·       Dagster;

·       Rflow;

·       Azure Data Factory;

·       Apache Spark / PySpark;

·       Delta Lake;

·       Collibra of andere data governance-oplossingen;

·       Terraform of Bicep;

·       AI/ML-workloads op moderne dataplatformen;

·       Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI of andere AI-services.

Data & AI bij adesso

Een goed dataplatform is voor ons geen einddoel. Het is de basis waarop organisaties analytics, machine learning en steeds vaker AI en agentic toepassingen kunnen bouwen.

Binnen ons Data & AI-team brengen we Data Engineering, Data Science en AI samen. Daardoor kijk je als architect niet alleen naar waar de data vandaag voor wordt gebruikt, maar ook naar wat er morgen mogelijk moet zijn.

We willen daarbij niet technologie inzetten omdat het nieuw is. We willen architecturen ontwerpen die schaalbaar en beheersbaar zijn en daadwerkelijk waarde leveren bij onze klanten.

Als Data Platform Architect krijg je veel ruimte om daarin richting te geven. Aan klantprojecten, maar ook aan hoe we binnen adesso onze Data & AI-propositie verder ontwikkelen.

Waarom adesso?

Je komt terecht in een groeiend Data & AI-team waarin je veel invloed hebt op onze technische richting.

Je krijgt bij ons:

·       Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid binnen klantprojecten;

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

About the role

Taxfix builds more products for more customer segments, faster than before. As Senior Product Marketing Manager, you are the go-to-market partner embedded into a product team, from the first discovery conversation to scaling. You’re not just handed a final product to talk about it. You bring customer, market and competitive evidence into the decisions that shape what gets built from day one: which segments to target, what features to prioritize, how to create Aha moments. You influence what the product does, how it wins and whether people will pay. You also build the systems that keep this work running: from automated competitor and customer insights generation, to agentic workflows that let product teams run smaller launches themselves at high quality.

You work closely with Product, Engineering, Commercial, Growth Marketing and Paid Acquisition.

What you'll do

  • Taking one (or many) of our big bets to market. With high level of responsibility, autonomy and direct support from senior leaders and domain experts, you will help us launch assisted and AI-native experiences that customers truly love.

  • Bring the market into product decisions. Turn customer, market and competitive evidence into clear recommendations for the product team. Join discovery work and design sprints where market specifics shape what gets built.

  • Choose who to serve, and who not to. Break users and products down into needs, pains, and functional and emotional value. Define sharp ICPs and decide which segment to win first and later.

  • Position the product to win. Define the competitive alternatives, what makes the product different and why it wins. Turn that into a sharp messaging and shape the pricing and packaging inputs.

  • Run launches as tests. Run lean tests early, report what the measures show, and adapt the product, the positioning and the go-to-market. You gather evidence that improves our GTM decision quality, not tick off a launch checklist.

  • Align the people around the work. Bring structure to complex go-to-market work: clear owners, milestones, decision points and success measures. Facilitate decisions across Product, Engineering, Data, Growth and commercial teams.

  • Build the insight engine. Replace ad hoc research with automated flows of competitor and customer insight that product and marketing teams use every week.

  • Own part of the context system. Turn each go-to-market decision and artifact into governed context that empowers people and agents alike.

  • Build with AI. Build your own prototypes, applets and automations for the opportunities you prioritize, and help product teams self-serve lower-tier launches at quality.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of bringing tech products to market. You have successfully taken complex products or features from discovery to launch and adoption, in a fast-paced environment.

  • Data- and evidence-driven over opinion. You set clear targets, success definitions and guardrails. You analyze data and derive actionable next steps. When evidence contradicts the plan, you say so, including to senior stakeholders.

  • Customer insight and craft. You stay close enough to users to quote them. You turn what they said into why they behave as they do, and into a narrative people remember.

  • AI as a builder. You build agents, automated workflows, prototypes and context towards clear milestones or outcomes.

  • Communication and project leadership. You write and speak with precision, align several teams at once and keep many moving pieces on track.

  • High agency and curiosity. You find the problem and solve it without waiting to be told, and you carry it like an owner.

  • Bias for action. You prioritize speed of learning and progress over perfection.

  • English and German. You use German to write customer-facing messaging and English to work with the wider team.

Why Taxfix? 

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager

🌍 About us

Plinth is a fast-growing tech startup working with charities, foundations and local government. Small and local charities are highly effective but largely hidden. They have no spare time and no spare money. We're building the tools these organisations need and shining a light on the work they do. Read more on our blog.

🚀We're growing fast. 3-4x this year. We get 7+ new clients a month and we're shipping new features every few days. This means things move quickly and your work directly shapes how we scale. You'll have real responsibility from day one.

❤️It's really impactful work. Our clients are charities and grassroots organisations across the UK, and soon internationally. When you help them succeed with our platform, you're directly amplifying their impact. Every successful onboarding means a charity spends less time fighting with their systems and more time on their actual mission.

🤝You'll work with impressive people. Our team is talented, collaborative and slightly strange(?). We value impact, speed and openness. We work in person in our office in Old Street because we genuinely enjoy each other's company (most of the time). It’s a high trust, creative space where if you think something's a good idea, you just go do it.

💼 You need to be able to:

  • Work both fast and slow: You'll navigate slow public sector procurement cycles one minute, then help us ship a new feature over lunch the next. The whiplash is intense but it keeps things interesting.

  • Keep it real: You'll be getting the train to community centres and youth clubs where the heating doesn't work and where the paint is peeling off the walls. It’s rarely glamourous. You need to be willing to meet clients where they are, literally and figuratively.

  • Listen to problems, ignore solutions: Clients will tell you exactly what they think they need. Your job is to understand the actual problem and guide them to what will really work, even when they're convinced they already know the answer. This requires self-confidence, understanding of the platform and genuine listening in equal measure.

  • Teach people: Most of our clients don't love shiny gadgets. If you're the kind of person who enjoys teaching your gran to use a smartphone, this is ideal. You need to explain some fairly complex systems clearly without being condescending and still getting user adoption

  • Automate and document yourself away:🤖 We're small and growing fast. Build systems and processes that make your job increasingly redundant. There’s always plenty more to do.

  • Understand the difference between "urgent" and 🚨 URGENT — When you're managing 4-8 concurrent client projects and everyone thinks their issue is critical, you need to distinguish between what must happen for launch versus what can wait. This is harder than it sounds.

  • Grow with the role: we need someone who is comfortable with our clients and team doubling every 6 months. Your role will rapidly change to reflect that, but it leaves you with lots of room to grow in responsibility.

🧩 What kind of background do we think would be a good fit?

We’d expect a few years experience in something like the following:

  • Coaching / Tutoring: You know how to meet people where they are and guide them to better outcomes

  • Hospitality management: Service mindset, de-escalation skills, managing expectations when things don't go to plan, letting the customer think they’re right when they aren’t

  • Event/production management: Used to juggling moving pieces, keeping stakeholders calm, making last-minute pivots when things go wrong

  • Community organising/activism: Already comfortable in the spaces you'll be visiting, get the mission, used to working with limited resources

  • Consulting: You're used to parachuting into chaos, extracting actionable tasks, and keeping multiple clients calm simultaneously

  • User research/UX: Good at understanding what people actually need versus what they say they need, synthesising feedback into actionable insights

  • Knowledge of the charity sector is a significant advantage, whether that’s as an employee, consultant or as a long term volunteer.

  • It would also definitely be helpful if you have any technical experience to help with managing data migrations.

Importantly, This is a list of suggestions.

If you have experience in only some of this, or have only some of these skills, please do apply anyway.

📈 How can you measure your success?

  • Speed of getting customers successfully using Plinth: From signed contract to actively using the platform and seeing value.

  • Positive recommendations: Clients recommending us positively to their networks — it’s a big source of our growth.

  • Increasing use of Plinth: Clients expanding how they use the platform over time, not just maintaining baseline usage

🧠 The role

Client Onboarding (70%) — Lead onboarding from kick-off to go-live. Break down complex projects into clear phases. Manage timelines, priorities, and expectations across 7+ new clients per month. Stay on top of new features we ship every few days. Push back when needed and teach anyone regardless of background.

Operations & Process Improvement (30%) — Audit and optimise our support systems (expect to manage Intercom chat a couple of days a week). Refine onboarding workflows. Keep documentation current. Work with engineering to communicate what's urgent versus what's just a problem. Track feature requests across clients and synthesise them into product improvements.

💵 What we offer

  • Salary: £42,000 - £75,000 depending on experience

  • Equity as part of your package

  • Location: In-person, Old Street, London

☎️ Interview process

  1. Quick (20-30 min) call with Chris as a sanity check

  2. First interview with Chris and a co-founder

  3. Long (2-3 hour), quite intense, in-person interview — meet the team, do tasks, respond to case studies, be challenged

  4. Decision

jobs.title: Senior Radiochemist
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Transmutex is a Swiss company founded in 2019. Transmutex is currently advancing the HI-BEAM (High Intensity Breakthrough Engineering for Advanced Medicine) project, an ambitious programme to develop an industrial-scale facility for the reliable production of medical-grade Actinium-225 (Ac-225), a critical radionuclide for emerging targeted alpha therapies. 

Our team spans nuclear physics, engineering, software, radiochemistry, pharmaceutical and industrial development. Working with research labs and industrial partners worldwide, we are building the production capacity needed for the next generation of cancer treatments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the HI-BEAM project progresses from conceptual design into experimental validation, Transmutex is expanding its radiochemistry capability to translate established laboratory methods—supported by collaboration with leading international research institutes—into automated, reproducible, and commercially viable production processes.

We are seeking a Senior radiochemist to actively contribute to the technical design of Transmutex’ s radiochemistry process, in strong collaboration with renowned research labs. You will report to the Head of Extraction unit and be part of a small international team

You will primarily be based in Vernier, GE, with regular travel to Villigen, AG and to partner research labs in North America.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Process development:

  • Design and optimize radiochemical separation and purification.
  • Collaborate across teams to develop radiochemical processes and methodology.
  • Perform radiochemical and chemical analyses, including alpha and gamma spectrometry.
  • Track radiochemistry developments and adopt relevant innovations and best practices.

Industrialization and operations:

  • Develop the radiochemical process flowsheet, including unit operations, process parameters, material balances, cycle times and waste streams.
  • cale up and transfer laboratory processes to a robust and GMP-compliant production line.
  • Define process, equipment, utility, instrumentation and facility-interface requirements.
  • Support equipment selection, sizing, qualification, commissioning and process validation.
  • Develop operating procedures, batch records, control strategies and consumables requirements.
  • Prepare laboratory and production operations aligned with capacity and customer needs.
  • Train and mentor colleagues.

Compliance, quality, and safety:

  • Work with QA and Safety to ensure regulatory compliance and meet applicable standards
  • Implement and monitor safety protocols and regulatory requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS AND PROFESSIONAL ACHIEVEMENTS

The candidates we are looking for must have:

  • PhD or Master’s degree in Radiochemistry, Nuclear Chemistry or related field
  • A minimum of 10 years of experience in radiochemistry.
  • Proven experience in radiochemical separation and purification with strong knowledge of actinide chemistry.
  • In-depth understanding of radiochemistry processes, equipment and tools.
  • Mastery of characterization, alpha or gamma spectrometry, ICP-MS, ICP-OES, liquid scintillation counting, or comparable analytical techniques.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of safety, radioprotection and GMP regulations and requirements. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with ability to collaborate effectively with multiple internal and external stakeholders across disciplines. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to address complex technical challenges.
  • Proven experience in translating lab-scale processes to GMP production line would be an asset
  • Fluent in English. Excellent knowledge of French or German would be an asset

TERMS AND CONDITIONS

  • Start date:          early 2027, and no later than April 2027
  • Location:            Vernier, GE, with monthly presence at Villigen, AG; Switzerland. This position also involves regular travels to North America.
  • Contract:            Full-time, permanent employment contract
  • Package:             We offer competitive remuneration and social security, accident/disability insurance and pension plans; one day per week work from home, as well as five weeks’ paid vacation.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS:

One to two technical interviews with the hiring manager, HR and other Transmutex team members; interview with Management for shortlisted candidates. At least one interview will be organized on-site in Geneva.

Je krijgt een zelfstandige rol waarin je verantwoordelijk bent voor analyses rondom de waarde, kosten en prestaties van ons wagenpark.

Je bent zelfstandig, analytisch en ondernemend. Je wacht niet af, maar neemt initiatief en pakt vraagstukken van begin tot eind op. Tegelijkertijd weet je wanneer je moet sparren met collega's of stakeholders.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Data Analist Valuation & Insights ben je verantwoordelijk voor het analyseren van ontwikkelingen binnen ons wagenpark. Je onderzoekt niet alleen wat er gebeurt, maar vooral waarom en wat dit betekent voor onze organisatie.

We're looking for people with passion, desire to learn and that are team players. You're encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

But also in the bigger things: celebrating the onboarding of new partners, growing our teams, and owning a strong discussion culture.

jobs.title: Community Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Forme mit uns die Events und Programme, die Gründungen in NRW voranbringen.

Der digihub sucht Verstärkung! Du brennst für die Start-up-Szene und willst Events, Formate und Communities aufbauen, die Gründungen voranbringen? Dann werde Teil des digihub Düsseldorf/Rheinland.

Der digihub Düsseldorf/Rheinland: Wo Gründungen wachsen und die Welt verändern. Wir vernetzen Mittelstand, Start-ups, Scale-ups, Konzerne, Wissenschaft und Investor:innen und begleiten sie bei der Entwicklung neuer digitaler Geschäftsmodelle, Produkte und Lösungen.

Dahinter steht ein kleines, schlagkräftiges Team mit starken Produkten: unser Accelerator ignition, Großveranstaltungen wie das Future Tech Fest (FTF), das Skalierungsprogramm Scale-up.NRW und unser SHE Innovates Tech Club sind unsere Kernmarken. In dieser Rolle arbeitest du programm- und formatübergreifend an unseren Events und am Innovationsökosystem, als Teil eines starken digihub-Teams, in dem wir uns gegenseitig unterstützen, Wissen teilen und gemeinsam an unseren Themen arbeiten.

Als Community Manager stehen bei dir Events und Formate im Mittelpunkt: Du konzipierst, organisierst und führst Veranstaltungen, Workshops und Netzwerkformate durch, die unsere Gründungs-Community zusammenbringen und unser Innovationsökosystem sichtbar machen. Rund um diese Formate entwickelst du Programme und Partnerschaften weiter, verantwortest Projekte von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung und behältst dabei Budget, Fördermittel und Wirkung im Blick.

So kannst du unser Team verstärken:

  • Dein Schwerpunkt: Du konzipierst, organisierst und führst Veranstaltungen, Workshops, Netzwerkformate und Acceleratorenprogramme durch. Von der Idee über die Planung bis zur Durchführung vor Ort sorgst Du für ein rundum gelungenes Teilnehmendenerlebnis.

  • Du vermarktest unserer Formate öffentlichkeitswirksam, aktivierst und bindest die Community rund um die Events und baust die Reichweite unserer Veranstaltungen zusammen mit dem Marketingteam kontinuierlich aus.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Programme und Eventformate zur Unterstützung von Start-ups und Innovationsprojekten weiter und bringst neue Formate an den Start.

  • Du baust strategische Partnerschaften im Ökosystem auf, pflegst sie und akquirierst neue Unternehmenspartnerschaften, darunter auch als Partner und Sponsoren unserer Events.

  • Du verantwortest Budget-, Zeit- und Ressourcensteuerung inkl. Kostenkontrolle, Reporting und fristgerechter Umsetzung und steuerst Förderprojekte inkl. Fördermittelmanagement, Budgetcontrolling und Abrechnung.

  • Du koordinierst die beteiligten Stakeholder, sorgst für eine erfolgreiche Projektumsetzung und erkennst neue Trends, Bedarfe und Kooperationsmöglichkeiten zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Ökosystems.

Das wünschen wir uns von unserem neuen Teammitglied:

In einem kleinen Team zählt die Persönlichkeit mindestens so viel wie der Lebenslauf. Deshalb sind uns diese Punkte wichtig:

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Organisation und Durchführung von Events, Workshops und Netzwerkformaten (idealerweise im Start-up-, Innovations- oder Förderumfeld).

  • Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Community-Management, sowie ausgeprägte Netzwerk- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, organisatorisches Talent und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität.

  • Führungskompetenz, hohe Belastbarkeit und Durchsetzungsstärke sowie Routine in der Steuerung externer Dienstleister und komplexer Projektstrukturen, besonders in intensiven Eventphasen.

  • Begeisterung für Innovation und Entrepreneurship.

  • Ein abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Studium oder einen Master- oder Diplomabschluss und mehrjährige Berufserfahrung.

  • Marketing- und/oder Social-Media-Erfahrung sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit Fördermitteln und administrativen Prozessen sind von Vorteil.

  • verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (entspricht C1)

Das bieten wir dir:

  • ein motiviertes, kollegiales Team mit flachen Hierarchien und einer Kultur, die wir gemeinsam weiterentwickeln

  • die Chance, ein internationales Projekt von Anfang an sichtbar mitzugestalten

  • flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zu anteiligem mobilem Arbeiten (Homeoffice)

  • die für deine Arbeit notwendige Ausstattung (Laptop, Diensthandy oder eSIM)

Das solltest du zur Stelle wissen:

  • Die Stelle ist projektgebunden im Rahmen einer STARK-Förderung und bis zum 14.09.2030 befristet.

  • Die maximale Vergütung erfolgt in Anlehnung an den TVöD nach Entgeltgruppe 13. Die konkrete Stufe richtet sich nach der einschlägigen Berufserfahrung.

  • Unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Deutsch. Da du auch mit Ausschreibungen, Verträgen und diversen Unternehmenspartnern zu tun haben wirst, solltest du also über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (entspricht C1) verfügen.

Beim digihub schätzen wir die Vielfalt und Einzigartigkeit jedes und jeder Einzelnen. Deshalb möchten wir den Bewerbungsprozess so zugänglich und inklusiv wie möglich gestalten. Du musst kein Anschreiben verfassen und auch kein Bewerbungsfoto beifügen. Wir wollen vor allem dich und deine Fähigkeiten kennenlernen.

Wir leben Inklusion und Diversität und begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen aller ethnischen Herkunft, Kultur, Sexualität und Identität. Bei uns wird niemand bevorzugt oder benachteiligt. Wir setzen auf eine faire und offene Auswahl.

Wenn du Teil eines Teams werden möchtest, das Vielfalt als Stärke betrachtet und Erfolge gemeinsam feiert, dann lade einfach deinen Lebenslauf hoch und teile uns mit, wer du bist und was du bewegen möchtest.

Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören!

Noch Fragen offen?

Melde dich gerne bei unserem Chief of Staff Tim Ohly.
